modules.title: 我吃完飯了，你呢？
modules.title_py: Wǒ chī wán fàn le, nǐ ne?
modules.title_id: I've finished eating — what about you?
modules.scene: Seven in the evening in the dorm kitchen. Your roommate has just come back from class and hasn't eaten yet. You share food, clear the dining table, and plan to watch a film once your homework is done.
can_do: Ask and answer whether someone has eaten/done something (吃過了嗎？／吃完了嗎？)
Tell 'already' (V過2) apart from 'ever' (V過1) when listening
Order your evening activities: finish A, then B (V完…就…／接著…)
modules.exam_link: Routines & housework are a FREQUENT topic in 聽力 Parts 1–2 and 閱讀 Parts 1–2. The polite phrase 吃過了 (a soft way to decline an invitation) is a typical implicature pattern in 聽力 Part 4.

lines.zh: 安妮，你吃過飯了嗎？
lines.py: Ān ní, nǐ chī guò fàn le ma?
lines.id: Annie, have you eaten?

lines.zh: 剛才吃過了。你呢？
lines.py: Gāng cái chī guò le. Nǐ ne?
lines.id: Yes, just now. And you?

lines.zh: 我剛下課，現在才要吃。
lines.py: Wǒ gāng xià kè, xiàn zài cái yào chī.
lines.id: I've just finished class; I'm only about to eat now.

lines.zh: 廚房裡還有一些炒飯，我做得太多了。你吃吧！
lines.py: Chú fáng lǐ hái yǒu yì xiē chǎo fàn, wǒ zuò de tài duō le. Nǐ chī ba!
lines.id: There's still some fried rice in the kitchen — I made too much. Have some!

lines.zh: 太好了！謝謝你！
lines.py: Tài hǎo le! Xiè xie nǐ!
lines.id: Great! Thank you!

lines.zh: 你吃完了嗎？吃完了，碗放在餐桌上，我來洗。
lines.py: Nǐ chī wán le ma? Chī wán le, wǎn fàng zài cān zhuō shàng, wǒ lái xǐ.
lines.id: Finished eating? If so, put the bowl on the dining table and I'll wash it.

lines.zh: 炒飯都吃光了，太好吃了！我自己洗就好。你功課寫完了嗎？
lines.py: Chǎo fàn dōu chī guāng le, tài hǎo chī le! Wǒ zì jǐ xǐ jiù hǎo. Nǐ gōng kè xiě wán le ma?
lines.id: The fried rice is all gone — it was delicious! I'll wash it myself. Have you finished your homework?

lines.zh: 寫完了。明天的考試，我也準備了。
lines.py: Xiě wán le. Míng tiān de kǎo shì, wǒ yě zhǔn bèi le.
lines.id: Yes. I've prepared for tomorrow's exam too.

lines.zh: 那我們接著看電影吧！這部電影很長，十一點才結束。
lines.py: Nà wǒ men jiē zhe kàn diàn yǐng ba! Zhè bù diàn yǐng hěn cháng, shí yī diǎn cái jié shù.
lines.id: Then let's watch a film after this! It's a long film — it won't finish until eleven.

lines.zh: 好啊！看完電影，我就去睡覺。
lines.py: Hǎo a! Kàn wán diàn yǐng, wǒ jiù qù shuì jiào.
lines.id: OK! When it's over, I'm going straight to bed.

lines.zh: 你看過這部電影嗎？
lines.py: Nǐ kàn guò zhè bù diàn yǐng ma?
lines.id: Have you seen this film before?

lines.zh: 看過，去年在印尼看過一次，可是我很想再看一次。
lines.py: Kàn guò, qù nián zài Yìn ní kàn guò yí cì, kě shì wǒ hěn xiǎng zài kàn yí cì.
lines.id: Yes, once last year in Indonesia, but I'd like to see it again.

lines.zh: 你昨天感冒了，今天吃過藥了嗎？
lines.py: Nǐ zuó tiān gǎn mào le, jīn tiān chī guò yào le ma?
lines.id: You had the flu yesterday — have you taken your medicine today?

lines.zh: 吃過了，現在好一點了。
lines.py: Chī guò le, xiàn zài hǎo yì diǎn le.
lines.id: Yes, I'm a bit better now.

picture.label: the plate is empty; he is full

tasks.question: 你吃完了嗎？
tasks.why: The plate is empty and he is full → 吃完了. B and C mean he is still eating or has just started, which does not match the empty plate.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture. Listen to the question and answers A–C, then choose the answer that matches the picture.
tasks.question: 媽媽在哪裡？
tasks.why: Mum is cooking in the kitchen → 在廚房做飯. A and C are a different place and activity.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 2 · One-turn question & answer
tasks.instr: Listen to the question, then choose the most suitable answer.
tasks.why: The question is whether he has eaten → 吃過了. A only says where the food is; C does not answer the question.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 2 · One-turn question & answer
tasks.instr: Listen to the sentence, then choose the most suitable response.
tasks.why: 幾點結束 → the finishing time. A judges the film; B gives the START time, not the end.

tasks.instr: Listen to the dialogue, then answer the question.

lines.zh: 你功課寫完了嗎？
英文寫完了，中文的還要寫一個小時。
那電影呢？我們九點看，好不好？
好，寫完功課，我們接著看電影。

tasks.question: 這位先生現在要先做什麼？
tasks.why: The English homework is done (寫完了); the Chinese homework needs another hour, and the film comes after that (接著). A is the next activity; C is already finished.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 4 · Dialogue + implied meaning
tasks.instr: Listen to the dialogue, then choose the correct answer.

lines.zh: 餐桌上的蛋糕呢？
我剛才看到小明在廚房裡吃。
那是我買給媽媽的生日蛋糕啊！
我看，已經吃光了吧。

tasks.question: 這位小姐的意思是什麼？
tasks.why: 已經吃光了吧 = it has probably all been eaten. A is reversed: the man bought the cake. B: the cake is no longer on the table. D: 小明 ate it.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 4 · Dialogue + implied meaning
tasks.instr: Listen to the dialogue, then choose the correct answer.

lines.zh: 你吃過藥了嗎？
吃過了，剛才吃完飯就吃了。
醫生說要吃飯以前吃啊！
真的嗎？那我明天要注意一點。

tasks.question: 這位小姐的意思是什麼？
options: 這位先生應該去看醫生
這位先生吃藥的時間不對
tasks.why: The medicine should be taken before meals, but he took it after eating → the timing is wrong. A: he did take it. B and C are not mentioned.

tasks.instr: Read the sentence, then choose the matching picture.
tasks.text: 他吃完飯，接著在餐桌上寫功課。

options.label: he is doing homework at the dining table

tasks.why: 吃完飯 (finished eating) + 接著寫功課 → doing homework at the dining table. A: he has already finished eating. C is not mentioned.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the matching sentence.
tasks.why: All the plates are empty → 吃光了. B and C mean there is still food.

tasks.part: 閱讀 Part 3 · Gap fill with picture
tasks.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the right word for the blank.
tasks.text: 電影十一點才（　），我們回家很晚。
tasks.why: They got home late because the film only ENDED at 11 → 結束. 開始 = start; 接著 = next/then, which cannot follow 才 here.

tasks.instr: Choose the right phrase for each blank. ONE option is not used.
tasks.text: 昨天我七點才下課，回到宿舍，覺得很餓。我到廚房一看，餐桌上（1），只有一碗炒飯。室友說：「那是我做的，你吃吧！」我很快就（2），真好吃。吃完飯，我洗了碗，然後（3）。十點功課寫完了，室友問我要不要一起看電影，我們就（4）。電影很長，十二點才（5），所以今天早上我很累。
tasks.why: (1) the table is almost empty, only fried rice. (2) finished it quickly (吃光了). (3) after eating and washing up → starts homework. (4) goes on to watch a film. (5) the film only ends at 12. 「已經吃過了」 contradicts the text: he came home hungry.

tasks.instr: Read this notice, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 我的室友安安每天都很忙。今天她早上八點就去學校了，晚上九點才回來。她說中午只吃了一個麵包，晚飯也沒吃。我剛才做了一些湯，還在廚房裡，就請她吃。她很快就吃光了，接著又去寫功課。她說功課明天早上要交，今天一定要寫完。
tasks.question: 這個人覺得安安今天怎麼樣？
tasks.why: Busy all day, only a bread roll, then finishes the soup quickly → busy and hungry. B contradicts 很快就吃光了. C: she only got back at 9 p.m. D: the homework 一定要寫完.

grammar.explain: 完 after a verb = the action is complete. 吃了 is just 'have eaten'; 吃完了 stresses 'have finished/it's all gone'. To ask: V完了嗎？ Negative: 沒V完. Often linked to the next activity: V完 + O，就 + V2.

examples.id: I've finished my homework.
When the film's over, I'm going straight to bed.

check.q: Choose the right word: 你的功課寫＿＿了嗎？寫完了，我們就去看電影。

grammar.explain: V過2 + 了 = the action HAS BEEN done (usual when asked 'have you … yet?'). Compare V過1 (learned in Vol.2) = to have EVER experienced: 我看過這部電影 (I've seen this film before). Quick clue: 了 at the end and a context of routine/today → V過2.

examples.id: I've just eaten.
Have you taken your medicine today?
(V過1) I've seen this film before.

core.meaning: to finish, to be over (吃完, 寫完)

core.note: This 義項 = 'used up'. 光 'light' and 'only' are not taught here.

modules.title: 房間又亂又髒！
modules.title_py: Fáng jiān yòu luàn yòu zāng!
modules.title_id: The room's messy and dirty!
modules.scene: Dawen's roommate, Zhiming, complains that the room is a mess. They tidy things up and plan to buy new furniture.
can_do: Make gentle requests with V一下 (看一下、洗一下)
Forbid with 別 (別放在沙發上)
Name furniture: 書架、書桌、櫃子、沙發、衣架
modules.exam_link: The state of the home & furniture appear in 聽力 Part 1 (pictures of rooms) and 閱讀 Parts 1–2 (dorm rules).

lines.zh: 大文，你的房間又亂又髒！
lines.py: Dà wén, nǐ de fáng jiān yòu luàn yòu zāng!
lines.id: Dawen, your room is messy and dirty!

lines.zh: 對不起，我最近太忙了。
lines.py: Duì bù qǐ, wǒ zuì jìn tài máng le.
lines.id: Sorry, I've been too busy lately.

lines.zh: 你的書別放在沙發上，放在書架上吧。
lines.py: Nǐ de shū bié fàng zài shā fā shàng, fàng zài shū jià shàng ba.
lines.id: Don't put your books on the sofa — put them on the bookshelf.

lines.zh: 好。書桌上的東西也太多了。
lines.py: Hǎo. Shū zhuō shàng de dōng xi yě tài duō le.
lines.id: OK. There's too much stuff on the desk as well.

lines.zh: 你看一下，衣服別放在椅子上，要掛在衣架上。
lines.py: Nǐ kàn yí xià, yī fú bié fàng zài yǐ zi shàng, yào guà zài yī jià shàng.
lines.id: Look, don't put clothes on the chair — they should go on hangers.

lines.zh: 好，我趕快洗一下衣服。
lines.py: Hǎo, wǒ gǎn kuài xǐ yí xià yī fú.
lines.id: OK, I'll wash my clothes right away.

lines.zh: 志明，我們的家具太舊了。
lines.py: Zhì míng, wǒ men de jiā jù tài jiù le.
lines.id: Zhiming, our furniture is too old.

lines.zh: 對，這個櫃子壞了。
lines.py: Duì, zhè ge guì zi huài le.
lines.id: Yes, this cupboard is broken.

lines.zh: 我們去看一下新的沙發吧。
lines.py: Wǒ men qù kàn yí xià xīn de shā fā ba.
lines.id: Let's go and look at new sofas.

lines.zh: 好，可是別買太貴的！
lines.py: Hǎo, kě shì bié mǎi tài guì de!
lines.id: OK, but let's not buy one that's too expensive!

tasks.question: 他的房間怎麼樣？
tasks.why: The room is messy and dirty → 又亂又髒. A is the opposite; C is not shown in the picture.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture. Listen to the question and answers A–C, then choose the answer that matches the picture.
tasks.question: 你覺得這個房間怎麼樣？
tasks.why: Things are everywhere → 太亂了. A is the opposite; C is not shown.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture. Listen to the question and answers A–C, then choose the answer that matches the picture.

picture.label: the host invites a guest to sit on the sofa

tasks.question: 他請你坐在哪裡？
tasks.why: The host points at the sofa → 沙發上. A and B are other places.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 2 · One-turn question & answer
tasks.instr: Listen to the question, then choose the most suitable answer.
tasks.why: 放在哪裡 → answer with a place: 書架上. A judges the book; B does not give a place.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 2 · One-turn question & answer
tasks.instr: Listen to the sentence, then choose the most suitable response.
tasks.audio: 這個櫃子壞了，我們去買一個新的，好嗎？
tasks.why: An invitation to buy a new cabinet → 好啊. B contradicts it (the cabinet is broken). C talks about something else.

tasks.instr: Listen to the dialogue, then answer the question.

lines.zh: 你的衣服怎麼都在沙發上？
衣架不夠了。
那你趕快去買幾個吧。
好，我等一下就去。

tasks.question: 這位小姐等一下要做什麼？
tasks.why: 衣架不夠 → he tells her 趕快去買幾個 (hangers). A is not mentioned. C: the sofa is only where the clothes are now.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 4 · Dialogue + implied meaning
tasks.instr: Listen to the dialogue, then choose the correct answer.

lines.zh: 你的房間怎麼這麼亂？
我這幾天太忙了。
你媽媽明天就來了，她看到會怎麼說？
我知道，我今天晚上一定讓它乾乾淨淨的。

tasks.question: 這位小姐的意思是什麼？
options: 這位先生應該讓房間乾淨一點
這位先生明天要去看媽媽
tasks.why: 她看到會怎麼說？ = your mum will not be happy to see this → clean up quickly. A: the man is the busy one. C is reversed: his mum is coming. D is the opposite.

tasks.instr: Read the sentence, then choose the matching picture.
tasks.text: 你看一下，衣服都掛在衣架上了。
tasks.why: 掛在衣架上 = hung on a hanger. A and C are other places.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the matching sentence.
options: 書都在書架上，一點也不亂。
tasks.why: The books are neatly on the shelf → 一點也不亂. A is the opposite; C: the books are on the shelf, not the desk.

tasks.part: 閱讀 Part 3 · Gap fill with picture
tasks.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the right word for the blank.
tasks.text: 九點上課，現在八點五十了，你（　）走吧！
tasks.why: Class is at 9 and it is 8:50 → 趕快 (hurry). 走一下 does not mean hurry; 別走 = don't go (the opposite).

tasks.instr: Choose the right phrase for each blank. ONE option is not used.
tasks.text: 我的室友大文很忙，所以他的房間常常（1）。昨天我跟他說：「你的衣服別放在椅子上，要（2）。」他說：「好，我等一下就掛。」可是今天我回家一看，衣服（3）。我很生氣，他就說：「對不起，我（4）。」現在他的房間乾淨多了，我們也想一起去（5）。
tasks.why: (1) a busy person's room: 又亂又髒. (2) advice: hang them on hangers. (3) the clothes were still on the chair. (4) apologises and hangs them at once. (5) plan to buy furniture. 「別放在書架上」 does not follow 要 in (2) and fits no other blank.

tasks.instr: Read these room rules, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 志明的房間又亂又髒，書桌上都是書，沙發上都是衣服。他的媽媽下個星期要來看他，所以他今天在家忙了一天：他洗了衣服，掛在衣架上；書都放在書架上。可是他的櫃子太舊了，門也壞了，他想買一個新的。他說，房間乾淨了，住得也比較舒服。
tasks.question: 志明今天為什麼在家忙了一天？
tasks.why: 媽媽下個星期要來看他，所以… → that is the reason. A is true about the cabinet, but it is not why he is busy today. B and D are not mentioned.

grammar.point: V一下 — for a moment / have a go
grammar.explain: 一下 after a verb makes an action sound brief & light, so requests sound more polite: 你看一下 (have a look), 等一下 (wait a moment), 洗一下衣服.

examples.id: Have a quick look.

examples.zh: 我們去看一下新的沙發吧。
examples.id: Let's go and look at new sofas.

check.q: A polite request: 'Please wait a moment'

grammar.explain: 別 = don't, the same as 不要 (B05) but shorter and more familiar. With 請 in front it is more polite.

examples.id: Don't put your books on the sofa.
Let's not buy one that's too expensive!

modules.title: 請把碗洗了。
modules.title_py: Qǐng bǎ wǎn xǐ le.
modules.title_id: Please wash the dishes.
modules.scene: Dawen and Zhiming share the housework: washing the dishes, doing the laundry in the machine, and taking out the rubbish from a torn bag.
can_do: Ask for something to be done to an object with 把 (把碗洗了)
Use 把 + V一V for light actions (把衣服洗一洗)
Talk about housework: 垃圾、洗衣機、乾、破、裝
modules.exam_link: 把 sentences are very common in 聽力 Parts 3–4 (instructions & requests) and 閱讀 Part 4 (paragraphs about housework).

lines.zh: 大文，請把碗洗了。
lines.py: Dà wén, qǐng bǎ wǎn xǐ le.
lines.id: Dawen, could you wash the dishes?

lines.zh: 好。你把衣服洗一洗吧，洗衣機在那裡。
lines.py: Hǎo. Nǐ bǎ yī fú xǐ yì xǐ ba, xǐ yī jī zài nà lǐ.
lines.id: OK. You do the laundry — the washing machine's over there.

lines.zh: 昨天的衣服都乾了嗎？
lines.py: Zuó tiān de yī fú dōu gān le ma?
lines.id: Are yesterday's clothes all dry?

lines.zh: 乾了。我把它們拿進來了。
lines.py: Gān le. Wǒ bǎ tā men ná jìn lái le.
lines.id: Yes. I've already brought them in.

lines.zh: 這個袋子破了，垃圾都掉了！
lines.py: Zhè ge dài zi pò le, lā jī dōu diào le!
lines.id: This bag's torn — all the rubbish has fallen out!

lines.zh: 你用別的袋子裝吧。
lines.py: Nǐ yòng bié de dài zi zhuāng ba.
lines.id: Just use another bag to put it in.

lines.zh: 好。可是這個袋子太小了。
lines.py: Hǎo. Kě shì zhè ge dài zi tài xiǎo le.
lines.id: OK. But this bag is too small.

lines.zh: 我來弄一弄。你把垃圾拿出去吧。
lines.py: Wǒ lái nòng yí nòng. Nǐ bǎ lā jī ná chū qù ba.
lines.id: Let me sort it out. You take the rubbish outside.

tasks.question: 媽媽要他做什麼？

tasks.instr: Look at the picture. Listen to the question and answers A–C, then choose the answer that matches the picture.

picture.label: trousers with a hole at the knee

tasks.question: 你的褲子怎麼了？
tasks.why: There is a hole at the knee → 破了. B and C are not shown in the picture.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 2 · One-turn question & answer
tasks.instr: Listen to the question, then choose the most suitable answer.
tasks.audio: 你可以幫我把垃圾拿出去嗎？
tasks.why: A request for help → 可以. A is unrelated; B only repeats the word 垃圾.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 2 · One-turn question & answer
tasks.instr: Listen to the sentence, then choose the most suitable response.
tasks.audio: 洗衣機裡的衣服乾了嗎？
tasks.why: The question is whether they are dry → 還不太乾. A talks about the machine; C does not answer.

tasks.instr: Listen to the dialogue, then answer the question.

lines.zh: 衣服都洗好了嗎？
洗好了，可是外面下雨，衣服都不乾。
那你把衣服拿進來吧。
好，我把它們放在房間裡。

tasks.question: 這位先生要把衣服放在哪裡？
tasks.why: 把它們放在房間裡. A: it is raining outside, which is why the clothes come in. B: the wash is already done.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 4 · Dialogue + implied meaning
tasks.instr: Listen to the dialogue, then choose the correct answer.

lines.zh: 你怎麼用洗衣機洗這件衣服？
怎麼了？
這件衣服很貴，要用手洗。你看，已經破了。
對不起，我不知道。

tasks.question: 這位先生是什麼意思？
options: 這位小姐應該買新洗衣機
衣服破了是因為用洗衣機洗
tasks.why: 要用手洗…已經破了 → it was damaged by the washing machine. A is not mentioned. B is the opposite (很貴). D misreads the word 手.

tasks.instr: Read the sentence, then choose the matching picture.

tasks.text: 吃完飯，請你把碗洗（　）。

tasks.instr: Choose the right phrase for each blank. ONE option is not used.
tasks.text: 星期六早上，我跟室友都在家。室友說：「你把碗（1），我來洗衣服。」我洗完碗，去看洗衣機，衣服（2），可是還在洗衣機裡。室友忘了（3）。我們就（4）。下午天氣很好，衣服很快就（5）。
tasks.why: (1) 把碗洗一洗 = please wash the dishes. (2) the wash is done. (3) forgot to take the clothes out. (4) hang them outside. (5) dry quickly. 「把垃圾裝好」 has nothing to do with the laundry sequence.

tasks.instr: Read this chore rota, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 我跟室友一起住。我們說好了：我洗碗，他拿垃圾出去。上個星期他很忙，垃圾都沒拿出去，廚房裡的垃圾袋也破了，味道很不好。我就自己把垃圾拿出去了。他回來以後，很不好意思，說下個星期他來洗碗。
tasks.question: 室友為什麼覺得不好意思？

grammar.point: 把 O V(一)V — (quickly) do something to O
grammar.explain: 把 moves the object IN FRONT of the verb to stress what is done to it. V一V (洗一洗, 弄一弄) makes the action sound light/brief.

examples.id: You wash the clothes, OK?

grammar.point: 把 O V了 — get O done
grammar.pattern: S + 把 + O + V + 了
grammar.explain: 把 O V了 stresses that the object gets 'dealt with/finished': 把碗洗了 (get the dishes washed). The verb in a 把 sentence can't stand alone — it needs 了, a result, a direction, etc.

examples.id: Please wash the dishes.

core.meaning: to do; to make; to fix

tasks.instr: Choose the right phrase for each blank. ONE option is not used.
tasks.text: 上個星期我們搬家了。新房子有兩（1），樓上是臥室，樓下是客廳。搬家那天，爸爸說：「先把沙發（2）。」我跟哥哥一起把書桌（3），因為臥室在樓上。妹妹的小狗很怕人，一直在（4）。媽媽把花（5），她說花在外面比較好看。
tasks.why: (1) 兩層 = two floors. (2) the sofa goes in the living room. (3) the desk goes upstairs because the bedrooms are upstairs. (4) the dog hides under a chair. (5) flowers in the yard. 「有三座」 fits no blank.

tasks.instr: Read the text, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 我們的新房子有兩層。樓下有客廳和廚房，樓上有三個臥室。房子旁邊還有一個院子，有很多花。媽媽不太喜歡，因為院子太大，每天都要用很多時間；可是弟弟很高興，因為他可以在院子裡跟小狗玩。
tasks.question: 哪一個是對的？
tasks.why: 樓上有三個臥室 → all the bedrooms are upstairs. A: the kitchen is downstairs. B: the house has two floors. D is the opposite (弟弟很高興).

grammar.point: 把 O V在 + place — put … at …
grammar.pattern: S + 把 + O + V + 在 + place
grammar.explain: To say a thing is MOVED/PUT somewhere, Mandarin uses 把: 把沙發放在客廳 (not 放沙發在客廳 ✗).

examples.zh: 我們把沙發放在客廳吧。
examples.id: Let's put the sofa in the living room.

grammar.point: 把 O V到 + place + 來/去 — move … to …
grammar.pattern: S + 把 + O + V + 到 + place + (來/去)
grammar.explain: V到 + place = arrive at the destination; 來/去 shows the direction relative to the speaker: 把櫃子搬到臥室去 (carry it to the bedroom, away), 把它放到桌子上來 (put it on the table here).

examples.id: Carry the cupboard to the bedroom.

lines.zh: 志明，我明天去台中，我把鑰匙交給你。

tasks.instr: Choose the right phrase for each blank. ONE option is not used.
tasks.text: 我這個月的零用錢只有三千塊，可是現在才十號，我就（1）。媽媽說，買東西以前要想一想，這個東西是不是一定要買。所以我（2）：每天只帶一百塊出去，別的錢都放在書桌的櫃子裡，然後（3），把鑰匙交給姊姊。昨天我很想買一件新衣服，可是口袋裡的錢（4），所以我就（5）。

grammar.point: 把 O V + result — get O …
grammar.pattern: S + 把 + O + V + result (乾淨/完/錯…)
grammar.explain: 把 is often paired with the result of an action: 把房間弄乾淨 (get the room clean), 把錢用完 (use up the money). The result shows a change to the object.

examples.id: Have you cleaned your room?
I've spent all my money.

grammar.point: 把 N1 V給 N2 — give N1 to N2
grammar.pattern: S + 把 + thing + V給 + person
grammar.explain: The thing changing hands goes after 把, the recipient after V給: 把鑰匙交給你, 把信拿給我, 把錢寄給我.

examples.id: I'll hand the key to you.
My mum will send me some money.

grammar.point: duration + 沒 + V + 了 — haven't … for …
grammar.pattern: S + duration + 沒 + V + 了
grammar.explain: For 'haven't … for (a period)', the duration goes BEFORE 沒: 我兩天沒睡覺了, 她半年沒回家了. (Unlike positive sentences, where the duration goes after the verb — B10.)

lines.zh: 志明，我們的鄰居吵死了！

鄉下的環境好，夏天也比城市涼快得多。
可是鄉下沒有城市那麼方便吧？
對，買東西要開車，可是我覺得沒關係。

tasks.question: 這位小姐為什麼喜歡鄉下？
tasks.why: 環境好 + 涼快得多. A and C are the opposite: the countryside is less convenient and shopping needs a car.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 4 · Dialogue + implied meaning
tasks.instr: Listen to the dialogue, then choose the correct answer.

lines.zh: 你覺得住在市區怎麼樣？
很方便，走路五分鐘就有超市。
那你為什麼想搬到鄉下？
市區的房子沒有鄉下那麼大，我家的孩子需要院子。

tasks.question: 這位小姐為什麼想搬家？
tasks.why: 市區的房子沒有鄉下那麼大 + needs a yard → wants a bigger house. A is the opposite (很方便). C and D are not mentioned.

tasks.instr: Read the sentence, then choose the matching picture.
tasks.text: 這裡的環境很好，沒有城市那麼多車。

options.label: a traffic jam in the city

tasks.why: 環境很好 + 沒有城市那麼多車 → green and quiet. A and C are the opposite.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the matching sentence.
options: 這裡是市區，有很多高樓。
tasks.why: Tall buildings → 市區. A is the opposite; C is not shown.

tasks.part: 閱讀 Part 3 · Gap fill with picture
tasks.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the right word for the blank.

picture.label: the city is much more convenient

tasks.text: 城市比鄉下方便（　）。
tasks.why: 比 + Vs + 得多 = much more. 那麼 goes with 沒有; 不同 cannot follow an adjective like this.

tasks.instr: Choose the right phrase for each blank. ONE option is not used.
tasks.text: 我家以前在鄉下，後來搬到了市區。市區的生活（1），走路就可以到學校和超市。可是市區的房屋（2），我們家只能租一個小房子。夏天市區比鄉下（3），我常常想到鄉下的院子。爸爸說：「以後我們再搬回鄉下，過（4）。」我也覺得鄉下的環境（5）。
tasks.why: (1) the city is much more convenient. (2) city housing costs more → can only rent a small place. (3) the city is hotter → misses the country yard. (4) go back to life as it was. (5) the country environment is better. 「一點也不方便」 contradicts (1) and does not fit 環境.

tasks.instr: Read the text, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 很多年輕人覺得城市的生活比鄉下好得多，因為工作多，買東西也方便。可是我在台北住了五年，覺得城市的房屋太貴，環境也沒有鄉下那麼好。去年我搬到花蓮的鄉下，現在去市區要開車一個小時，可是每天都能看到山和海，我覺得這樣的生活很好。
tasks.question: 這個人覺得鄉下的生活怎麼樣？
options: 不太方便，可是他很喜歡
tasks.why: It takes an hour to get to town (less convenient), but 這樣的生活很好. B is the opposite. C: housing is expensive in the city. D: the jobs are in the city.

grammar.point: A 沒有 B (那麼/這麼) Vs — A isn't as … as B
grammar.pattern: A + 沒有 + B + (那麼) + Vs
grammar.explain: The negative form of comparison: A 沒有 B 那麼 Vs = A isn't as Vs as B (B is more Vs). 不比 is not used for this meaning.

examples.zh: 鄉下沒有城市那麼方便。
examples.id: The countryside isn't as convenient as the city.
Indonesia isn't as cold as Taiwan.

check.q: 'My younger brother isn't as tall as me' =

grammar.pattern: A + 比 + B + Vs + 得多
grammar.explain: 得多 after an adjective = much more: 冷得多, 好得多. It can be used without 比 if what is compared is clear. Don't use 很 (比印尼很冷 ✗).

examples.zh: 臺灣的冬天比印尼冷得多。
examples.id: Taiwan's winters are much colder than Indonesia's.

check.q: 'The train is much faster than the bus' =

modules.title: 生活費越來越貴了。
modules.title_py: Shēng huó fèi yuè lái yuè guì le.
modules.title_id: The cost of living keeps going up.
modules.scene: Dawen complains that his monthly money is never enough. He and Meimei talk about monthly spending and shopping habits.
can_do: Express gradual change: 越來越 + adjective
Say 'the more …, the more …': 越 A 越 B
Talk about spending: 生活費、花錢、一般、經常
modules.exam_link: 越來越／越…越… are a favourite pattern in 閱讀 Part 5 (essays about money & lifestyle) and 聽力 Part 4.

lines.zh: 大文，你的生活費夠嗎？
lines.py: Dà wén, nǐ de shēng huó fèi gòu ma?
lines.id: Dawen, do you have enough to live on?

lines.zh: 不夠。臺灣的東西越來越貴了！
lines.py: Bú gòu. Tái wān de dōng xi yuè lái yuè guì le!
lines.id: No. Things in Taiwan are getting more and more expensive!

lines.zh: 對。我一般一個月花一萬塊。
lines.py: Duì. Wǒ yì bān yí ge yuè huā yí wàn kuài.
lines.id: True. I usually spend ten thousand a month.

lines.zh: 我經常在日記裡寫我花了多少錢。
lines.py: Wǒ jīng cháng zài rì jì lǐ xiě wǒ huā le duō shǎo qián.
lines.id: I often write down in my diary how much money I've spent.

lines.zh: 你看我的日記：我越買越多，錢越來越少！
lines.py: Nǐ kàn wǒ de rì jì: wǒ yuè mǎi yuè duō, qián yuè lái yuè shǎo!
lines.id: Look at my diary: the more I shop, the more I buy, and the less money I have!

lines.zh: 加上房租，你的生活費很多。月底你還有錢嗎？
lines.py: Jiā shàng fáng zū, nǐ de shēng huó fèi hěn duō. Yuè dǐ nǐ hái yǒu qián ma?
lines.id: Add the rent, and your living costs are high. Do you still have money at the end of the month?

lines.zh: 月底我每天只吃饅頭。
lines.py: Yuè dǐ wǒ měi tiān zhǐ chī mán tou.
lines.id: At the end of the month I only eat mantou every day.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture. Listen to the question and answers A–C, then choose the answer that matches the picture.

picture.label: a graph of money going down and down

tasks.question: 他的錢怎麼樣？
tasks.why: The money graph keeps falling → 越來越少. A is the opposite; B does not match the graph.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture. Listen to the question and answers A–C, then choose the answer that matches the picture.

picture.label: a thermometer getting lower day by day

tasks.question: 天氣怎麼樣？
tasks.why: The thermometer keeps dropping → 越來越冷. A is the opposite; C shows no change.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture. Listen to the question and answers A–C, then choose the answer that matches the picture.

picture.label: she writes her diary in the evening

tasks.question: 他晚上經常做什麼？
tasks.why: Writing a diary at night → 寫日記. B and C are other activities.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 2 · One-turn question & answer
tasks.instr: Listen to the question, then choose the most suitable answer.
tasks.audio: 你一個月的生活費要多少？
tasks.why: The question asks for an amount → 一般要一萬兩千塊. A does not answer. C comments on costs but gives no amount.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 2 · One-turn question & answer
tasks.instr: Listen to the sentence, then choose the most suitable response.
tasks.why: The question is whether there is money left → 只有一百塊了. A does not answer; C is unrelated.

tasks.instr: Listen to the dialogue, then answer the question.

lines.zh: 你這個月的錢又花光了嗎？
對，我越買越多，每天都去夜市。
加上房租，你一個月花多少？
一萬五，比我的生活費還多三千塊。

tasks.question: 這位先生的生活費是多少？
tasks.why: Spending of 15,000 is 3,000 more than his allowance → 12,000. A is what he spends; C is the difference.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 4 · Dialogue + implied meaning
tasks.instr: Listen to the dialogue, then choose the correct answer.

lines.zh: 你怎麼每天都吃饅頭？
月底了，生活費快花完了。
你一般一個月花多少？
一萬，可是這個月加上看醫生的錢，多花了兩千。

tasks.question: 這位小姐為什麼每天吃饅頭？
tasks.why: End of the month + money almost gone (there was a doctor's bill) → saving money. A is not mentioned. C: the doctor only added to her costs; she was not told what to eat. D is not mentioned.

tasks.instr: Read the sentence, then choose the matching picture.
tasks.text: 妹妹越吃越胖，所以她現在不吃蛋糕了。
tasks.why: 越吃越胖 → now she no longer eats cake (refuses it). A is the opposite; C is not mentioned.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the matching sentence.

picture.label: an empty wallet, the money is gone

tasks.why: An empty wallet → 花光了. A and C are the opposite.

tasks.part: 閱讀 Part 3 · Gap fill with picture
tasks.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the right word for the blank.
tasks.text: 來學中文的人（　）多了。
tasks.why: 越來越 + Vs + 了 = more and more. 越 must come in a pair (越A越B); 經常多了 is not natural.

tasks.instr: Choose the right phrase for each blank. ONE option is not used.
tasks.text: 上大學以後，我一個人住在台北。臺灣的東西（1），我的生活費常常不夠。媽媽說：「你應該（2），看一下錢都花在哪裡。」我寫了一個月才發現，我（3），每天都買咖啡。（4），一個月要花三千塊！現在我一般只喝水，（5），月底也還有錢。
tasks.why: (1) prices keep rising → not enough money. (2) keep a diary of spending. (3) drinking more and more. (4) with snacks, 3,000 a month. (5) result: more and more money. 「越來越便宜」 contradicts the money running short.

tasks.instr: Read this diary, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 小林每個月的生活費是一萬塊，加上他在咖啡店工作的錢，一共一萬三。他經常在日記裡寫他每天花了多少錢。上個月他發現，他花最多錢的地方不是吃飯，是買衣服，也越買越多。這個月他決定每個星期只去一次百貨公司，月底還有兩千塊。
tasks.question: 小林這個月為什麼還有錢？
tasks.why: He realised clothes were his biggest expense → shopped less → money left over. A is not mentioned. C is not mentioned (he did not stop eating). D: his café job existed before, so it is not the new reason.

grammar.point: 越來越 + Vs — more and more …
grammar.explain: 越來越 expresses an ongoing change: 越來越貴 (more and more expensive), 越來越冷. It doesn't take 很 (越來越很貴 ✗).

examples.zh: 臺灣的東西越來越貴了！
examples.id: Things in Taiwan are getting more and more expensive!

check.q: 'His Mandarin is getting better and better' =

grammar.point: 越 A 越 B — the more A, the more B
grammar.pattern: S + 越 + V/Vs + 越 + V/Vs
grammar.explain: Two things change together: 越吃越胖 (the more he eats, the fatter he gets), 越買越多. The subjects can differ: 你越說，我越不懂.

examples.id: The more I shop, the more I buy.

examples.zh: 我經常去夜市，越吃越胖！
examples.id: I go to the night market so often — the more I eat, the fatter I get!

check.q: 'The more I think about it, the angrier I get' =

modules.title: 出門別忘了帶傘！
modules.title_py: Chū mén bié wàng le dài sǎn!
modules.title_id: Don't forget your umbrella when you go out!
modules.scene: Rainy season in Taipei: Meimei reminds Dawen to take an umbrella, and then the teacher makes an announcement about preparing for a study trip to the mountains.
can_do: Give polite instructions to a group: 請大家 + VP
Tell someone to stop: 別(再)…了 (別再走路了)
Talk about the weather: 陰天、晴天、溼、涼
modules.exam_link: Announcements by teachers/staff (請大家…) are classic material for 聽力 Part 4 and 閱讀 Part 3; questions ask what to bring/do.

lines.zh: 大文，今天是陰天，出門別忘了帶傘！
lines.py: Dà wén, jīn tiān shì yīn tiān, chū mén bié wàng le dài sǎn!
lines.id: Dawen, it's cloudy today — don't forget your umbrella when you go out!

lines.zh: 好。你看，外頭已經下雨了。
lines.py: Hǎo. Nǐ kàn, wài tou yǐ jīng xià yǔ le.
lines.id: OK. Look, it's already raining outside.

lines.zh: 你的鞋子都溼了！別再走路了，我們坐車吧。
lines.py: Nǐ de xié zi dōu shī le! Bié zài zǒu lù le, wǒ men zuò chē ba.
lines.id: Your shoes are soaked! Stop walking — let's take a bus.

lines.zh: 好。明天會是晴天嗎？
lines.py: Hǎo. Míng tiān huì shì qíng tiān ma?
lines.id: OK. Will it be sunny tomorrow?

lines.zh: 同學們，明天去山上，請大家帶雨衣和雨傘。山上很涼，請多穿一點衣服。
lines.py: Tóng xué men, míng tiān qù shān shàng, qǐng dà jiā dài yǔ yī hé yǔ sǎn. Shān shàng hěn liáng, qǐng duō chuān yì diǎn yī fú.
lines.id: Everyone, we're going to the mountains tomorrow — please all bring a raincoat and an umbrella. It's cool in the mountains, so wear warmer clothes.

lines.zh: 老師，如果是晴天呢？
lines.py: Lǎo shī, rú guǒ shì qíng tiān ne?
lines.id: Teacher, what if it's sunny?

lines.zh: 晴天也請帶，山上的天氣常常變。
lines.py: Qíng tiān yě qǐng dài, shān shàng de tiān qì cháng cháng biàn.
lines.id: Even if it's sunny, bring them anyway — the weather in the mountains often changes.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture. Listen to the question and answers A–C, then choose the answer that matches the picture.
tasks.question: 今天天氣怎麼樣？
tasks.why: Cloudy but not raining yet → 陰天. A is the opposite; C: it has not started raining.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture. Listen to the question and answers A–C, then choose the answer that matches the picture.

picture.label: mum hands over an umbrella at the door

tasks.question: 媽媽說什麼？
tasks.why: Mum hands over an umbrella at the door → 出門別忘了帶傘. A does not match the picture; C: you don't need an umbrella when it's sunny.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture. Listen to the question and answers A–C, then choose the answer that matches the picture.
tasks.question: 今天天氣怎麼樣？
tasks.why: A clear sky → 晴天. A and B are bad weather.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 2 · One-turn question & answer
tasks.instr: Listen to the question, then choose the most suitable answer.
tasks.why: The question is whether it is raining → 下了. B and C do not describe the weather now.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 2 · One-turn question & answer
tasks.instr: Listen to the sentence, then choose the most suitable response.
tasks.why: The question asks WHY the shoes are wet → no umbrella. B and C give no reason.

tasks.instr: Listen to the dialogue, then answer the question.

lines.zh: 今天是陰天，要帶傘嗎？
早上是晴天，下午可能會下雨。
那我帶雨衣吧，雨傘太大了。
好，別再忘了，上次你的衣服都溼了。

tasks.question: 這位先生要帶什麼？
tasks.why: 雨傘太大了 → he takes the 雨衣. A is only asked about; C contradicts 那我帶雨衣吧.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 4 · Dialogue + implied meaning
tasks.instr: Listen to the dialogue, then choose the correct answer.

lines.zh: 你帶傘了嗎？外面好像要下雨了。
沒關係，我開車。
可是你要走到公司，要走十分鐘啊！
那好吧，我帶你的傘。

tasks.question: 這位先生要帶什麼？
tasks.why: 我帶你的傘 → the woman's umbrella. A: he doesn't mention his own. C is not mentioned. D was his first attitude, which changes.

tasks.instr: Read the sentence, then choose the matching picture.
tasks.text: 外面下著雨，她穿著雨衣去上學。

options.label: wearing a raincoat in the rain

tasks.why: 下著雨 + 穿著雨衣 → a raincoat in the rain. A is an umbrella, not a raincoat. C shows no rain.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the matching sentence.
tasks.why: Thick clouds → 陰天. B and C do not match.

tasks.part: 閱讀 Part 3 · Gap fill with picture
tasks.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the right word for the blank.
tasks.text: 今天會下雨，你出門要穿（　）。
tasks.why: The verb 穿 → 雨衣 (worn on the body). 雨傘 goes with 帶/拿; 晴天 is not an object.

tasks.instr: Choose the right phrase for each blank. ONE option is not used.
tasks.text: 上個週末我跟朋友去山上玩。出門以前是晴天，所以我（1）。到了山上，天氣就變了，是（2），下午開始下大雨。我們的衣服和鞋子都（3）。山上又（4），我覺得很冷。朋友說：「（5），我們坐車回去吧。」
tasks.why: (1) sunny → no umbrella. (2) it turns cloudy. (3) soaked by the rain. (4) cold on the mountain. (5) stop walking, take a ride. 「請大家帶雨衣」 is the teacher's instruction and fits no blank.

tasks.instr: Read this notice, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 各位同學：明天我們要去陽明山。山上的天氣常常變，早上是晴天，下午可能就下雨了。請大家帶雨衣，也請多帶一件衣服，因為山上比市區涼。早上八點在學校門口見，請大家早點到。中午我們在山上吃飯，請自己帶水。
tasks.question: 老師為什麼請大家多帶一件衣服？
tasks.why: 因為山上比市區涼 → that is the reason. A and B are reasons for the raincoat/umbrella, not the extra clothes. D is the opposite.

grammar.explain: In announcements or formal instructions, 請 + person + activity = 'please …': 請大家帶雨衣, 請多穿一點衣服.

examples.id: Please all bring a raincoat and an umbrella.

grammar.explain: 別…了 asks someone to STOP doing something they are doing/have done; 再 stresses 'any more'. 別忘了 = don't forget.

examples.zh: 別再走路了，我們坐車吧。
examples.id: Stop walking — let's take a bus.
Don't forget your umbrella when you go out!

modules.title: 我是在雅加達出生的，在台北長大。
modules.title_py: Wǒ shì zài Yǎ jiā dá chū shēng de, zài Tái běi zhǎng dà.
modules.title_id: I was born in Jakarta and grew up in Taipei.
modules.scene: Annie is interviewed for a scholarship: she talks about where she was born, her childhood, her mother tongue and her schooling.
can_do: Tell your life story: 出生、長大、上國小/中學
Say 'when …': …的時候
Put a story in order with 然後
modules.exam_link: Life stories & interviews appear in 聽力 Part 4 and 閱讀 Part 4 (first-person narrative paragraphs).

lines.zh: 請你介紹一下自己。
lines.py: Qǐng nǐ jiè shào yí xià zì jǐ.
lines.id: Please introduce yourself.

lines.zh: 我是在雅加達出生的，在台北長大。
lines.py: Wǒ shì zài Yǎ jiā dá chū shēng de, zài Tái běi zhǎng dà.
lines.id: I was born in Jakarta and grew up in Taipei.

lines.zh: 你的母語是什麼？
lines.py: Nǐ de mǔ yǔ shì shén me?
lines.id: What's your mother tongue?

lines.zh: 我的母語是印尼話。我上國小的時候，才來臺灣。
lines.py: Wǒ de mǔ yǔ shì Yìn ní huà. Wǒ shàng guó xiǎo de shí hòu, cái lái Tái wān.
lines.id: My mother tongue is Indonesian. I only came to Taiwan when I was at primary school.

lines.zh: 然後呢？
lines.py: Rán hòu ne?
lines.id: And then?

lines.zh: 然後我在台北上中學，現在是大學生。
lines.py: Rán hòu wǒ zài Tái běi shàng zhōng xué, xiàn zài shì dà xué shēng.
lines.id: Then I went to secondary school in Taipei, and now I'm a university student.

lines.zh: 你今年幾歲？
lines.py: Nǐ jīn nián jǐ suì?
lines.id: How old are you this year?

lines.zh: 二十一歲。
lines.py: Èr shí yī suì.
lines.id: Twenty-one.

lines.zh: 你的住址是什麼？
lines.py: Nǐ de zhù zhǐ shì shén me?
lines.id: What's your address?

lines.zh: 台北市中山路二十號。
lines.py: Tái běi shì Zhōng shān lù èr shí hào.
lines.id: No. 20, Zhongshan Road, Taipei.

lines.zh: 你去過大陸嗎？
lines.py: Nǐ qù guò dà lù ma?
lines.id: Have you been to mainland China?

lines.zh: 去過。那時我年紀很小，才八歲，當時我不會說中文。
lines.py: Qù guò. Nà shí wǒ nián jì hěn xiǎo, cái bā suì, dāng shí wǒ bú huì shuō Zhōng wén.
lines.id: Yes. I was little then, only eight, and at that time I couldn't speak Mandarin yet.

tasks.question: 你小的時候住在哪裡？
tasks.why: A house in the country → 鄉下. A and B are places in town.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 2 · One-turn question & answer
tasks.instr: Listen to the question, then choose the most suitable answer.
tasks.why: The question asks where he grew up → 在台中長大的. A gives his age; C his status.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 2 · One-turn question & answer
tasks.instr: Listen to the sentence, then choose the most suitable response.
tasks.why: 母語 = mother tongue → 印尼話. A is unrelated. C names a language she is learning, not her mother tongue.

tasks.instr: Listen to the dialogue, then answer the question.

lines.zh: 你是在台北出生的嗎？
不是，我是在高雄出生的。
那你在高雄長大嗎？
我三歲的時候就搬到台北了，然後一直住在這裡。

tasks.question: 這位先生在哪裡長大？
tasks.why: Moved to Taipei at three and has lived there since → grew up in 台北. A is where he was born. C is not mentioned.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 4 · Dialogue + implied meaning
tasks.instr: Listen to the dialogue, then choose the correct answer.

lines.zh: 你的中文說得真好，你是華人嗎？
對，我爸爸媽媽都是華人，可是我是在美國長大的。
那你怎麼說得這麼好？
我小的時候，爸媽在家只跟我說中文。

tasks.question: 這位小姐的中文為什麼說得很好？
tasks.why: 爸媽在家只跟我說中文 → that is the reason. A is wrong: she grew up in America. C and D are not mentioned.

tasks.instr: Read the sentence, then choose the matching picture.
tasks.text: 這是爺爺小時候的照片，當時他才五歲。
tasks.why: 小時候 + 當時才五歲 → a photo of a small child. A is grandpa today; C is too young (a baby, not five).

tasks.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the matching sentence.
tasks.why: An old man → 年紀很大了. B and C are young people.

tasks.part: 閱讀 Part 3 · Gap fill with picture
tasks.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the right word for the blank.
tasks.text: 我是在醫院（　）的。
tasks.why: A baby in hospital → 在醫院出生. 在醫院長大 makes no sense; 年紀 is a noun.

tasks.instr: Choose the right phrase for each blank. ONE option is not used.
tasks.text: 我是在泗水出生的，我的（1）是印尼話。我十歲的時候，爸爸到台北工作，我們就（2）。（3）我一句中文也不會說，上國小的時候，同學說什麼我都聽不懂。然後我每天放學以後都去學中文，（4），我的中文越來越好。現在我是（5），在台北念書。
tasks.why: (1) mother tongue. (2) moved to Taiwan. (3) 當時 = at that time. (4) after starting middle school it improved. (5) now a university student. 「在大陸出生」 contradicts the text: she was born in Surabaya.

tasks.instr: Read the text, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 陳先生是在印尼出生的華人。他的母語是印尼話，可是他爸爸媽媽在家都說中文。他上中學的時候，全家搬到臺灣，然後他在台北上大學。當時他的中文不太好，上課很辛苦。現在他已經在臺灣住了二十年了，他說：「台北就是我的第二個家。」
tasks.question: 陳先生覺得台北怎麼樣？
tasks.why: 台北就是我的第二個家 → like his own home. B describes the PAST (當時). C is not mentioned. D is not his opinion of Taipei.

grammar.explain: …的時候 = when …, placed AFTER the event (unlike English 'when' at the front). 當 can be added in front in written style.

examples.zh: 我上國小的時候，才來臺灣。
examples.id: I only came to Taiwan when I was at primary school.

examples.zh: 她八歲的時候，家人帶她來臺灣。
examples.id: When she was eight, her family brought her to Taiwan.

grammar.explain: 然後 links events in sequence in a story. It is often paired with 先 (先…然後…). It is also used to ask for the rest of a story: 然後呢？

examples.id: Then I went to secondary school in Taipei.
And then?

check.q: Putting things in order: 'I eat first, then sleep.'

modules.title: 我外婆有好幾個孫子。
modules.title_py: Wǒ wài pó yǒu hǎo jǐ ge sūn zi.
modules.title_id: My grandmother (on my mother's side) has quite a few grandchildren.
modules.scene: Dawen and Meimei explain their extended family trees: grandparents on the mother's side, aunts, uncles and cousins.
can_do: Say 'quite a few' with 好幾／好多 + measure word
Pick 'among them' with 其中
Name extended family members: 外公、外婆、姑姑、伯父、伯母、孫子
modules.exam_link: Extended-family terms appear in 閱讀 Parts 4–5; questions often ask you to count or identify relationships (其中…).

lines.zh: 大文，你的家人很多嗎？
lines.py: Dà wén, nǐ de jiā rén hěn duō ma?
lines.id: Dawen, is your family big?

lines.zh: 很多！我外婆有好幾個孫子和孫女，其中我最小。
lines.py: Hěn duō! Wǒ wài pó yǒu hǎo jǐ ge sūn zi hé sūn nǚ, qí zhōng wǒ zuì xiǎo.
lines.id: Big! My grandma has quite a few grandsons and granddaughters, and I'm the youngest of them.

lines.zh: 你有幾個兄弟？
lines.py: Nǐ yǒu jǐ ge xiōng dì?
lines.id: How many brothers do you have?

lines.zh: 我只有一個哥哥，沒有弟弟。
lines.py: Wǒ zhǐ yǒu yí ge gē ge, méi yǒu dì di.
lines.id: I only have one older brother, and no younger brothers.

lines.zh: 你外公呢？
lines.py: Nǐ wài gōng ne?
lines.id: And your grandfather (on your mother's side)?

lines.zh: 我外公今年八十多歲了。
lines.py: Wǒ wài gōng jīn nián bā shí duō suì le.
lines.id: My grandpa is over eighty this year.

lines.zh: 美美，姑姑和姑媽一樣嗎？
lines.py: Měi měi, gū gu hé gū mā yí yàng ma?
lines.id: Meimei, are 姑姑 and 姑媽 the same?

lines.zh: 一樣，都是我爸爸的姊姊或是妹妹。
lines.py: Yí yàng, dōu shì wǒ bà ba de jiě jie huò shì mèi mei.
lines.id: Yes, they're both my dad's sisters.

lines.zh: 伯父和伯母呢？
lines.py: Bó fù hé bó mǔ ne?
lines.id: What about 伯父 and 伯母?

lines.zh: 伯父是我爸爸的哥哥，伯母是他的太太。過年的時候，我家有好多人！
lines.py: Bó fù shì wǒ bà ba de gē ge, bó mǔ shì tā de tài tai. Guò nián de shí hòu, wǒ jiā yǒu hǎo duō rén!
lines.id: 伯父 is my dad's older brother, and 伯母 is his wife. At Lunar New Year my home is really lively!

tasks.instr: Look at the picture. Listen to the question and answers A–C, then choose the answer that matches the picture.

picture.label: a grandmother with lots of grandsons

tasks.question: 奶奶有幾個孫子？
tasks.why: Grandma surrounded by many grandsons → 好幾個. A and B are the wrong number.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture. Listen to the question and answers A–C, then choose the answer that matches the picture.

picture.label: a grandmother (mother's side) with four grandchildren

tasks.question: 你外婆有幾個孫子？
tasks.why: Grandma with four grandchildren → 四個. A and C are the wrong number.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture. Listen to the question and answers A–C, then choose the answer that matches the picture.
tasks.question: 你有幾個兄弟？
tasks.why: 'Me' with two brothers → 兩個兄弟. B is the wrong gender; C is the opposite.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 2 · One-turn question & answer
tasks.instr: Listen to the question, then choose the most suitable answer.
tasks.why: The question asks how many grandchildren → 好幾個. A gives an age; C is unrelated.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 2 · One-turn question & answer
tasks.instr: Listen to the sentence, then choose the most suitable response.
tasks.why: 伯母 = the wife of 伯父. A gives where she lives. B is the wrong relationship (mum's older sister = 阿姨).

tasks.instr: Listen to the dialogue, then answer the question.

lines.zh: 你爸爸有幾個兄弟姊妹？
三個。一個哥哥，兩個妹妹。
那你有幾個姑姑？
兩個，我也有一個伯父。

tasks.question: 這位小姐的伯父是誰？
tasks.why: 伯父 = father's older brother; her father has one older brother. B = 姑姑. C = mum's brother (not 伯父).

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 4 · Dialogue + implied meaning
tasks.instr: Listen to the dialogue, then choose the correct answer.

lines.zh: 這張照片裡的人都是你的家人嗎？
對，這是我外公外婆，旁邊是他們的孫子。
好多人啊！哪一個是你？
最左邊的，其中我年紀最大。

tasks.question: 哪一個是對的？
options: 這位先生是外公外婆的孩子
這位先生是外公外婆年紀最大的孫子
tasks.why: 他們的孫子…其中我年紀最大 → the eldest grandchild. A contradicts 好多人. B: he is a grandchild, not a child. D is not mentioned.

tasks.instr: Read the sentence, then choose the matching picture.
tasks.text: 外婆坐在中間，旁邊站著好幾個孫子。
tasks.why: 外婆 + 好幾個孫子 → grandma with many grandchildren. A has the wrong person and number; C has no grandchildren.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the matching sentence.
options: 過年的時候，我家有好多人。
tasks.why: A big family → 好多人. A and C are small families.

tasks.part: 閱讀 Part 3 · Gap fill with picture
tasks.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the right word for the blank.
tasks.text: 爸爸的哥哥，我叫他（　）。
tasks.why: Father's older brother = 伯父. 姑姑 = father's sister; 外公 = mother's father.

tasks.instr: Choose the right phrase for each blank. ONE option is not used.
tasks.text: 我爸爸有三個兄弟，他是（1）。我的伯父住在美國，（2）他們一家人才回臺灣一次。我的姑姑很喜歡孩子，每次來我家都（3）。媽媽說，姑姑（4），叫她姑媽也可以。我覺得我家（5），過年的時候大家都很高興。
tasks.why: (1) dad is the youngest of them. (2) only comes back once every few years. (3) always brings lots of things. (4) 姑姑 = dad's younger sister (same as 姑媽). (5) a big family, everyone happy at New Year. 「有好幾個孫女」 fits no blank.

tasks.instr: Read the text, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 過年的時候，我們全家都去外婆家。外公外婆有三個孩子，其中我媽媽最小。外公外婆一共有七個孫子和孫女，其中只有我是女生。大家都很喜歡我，外婆每年都給我最多的紅包。
tasks.question: 哪一個是對的？
options: 她媽媽是外公外婆的大女兒
tasks.why: 其中只有我是女生 → the only granddaughter. B is the opposite (媽媽最小). C: seven is the number of grandchildren; there are three children. D contradicts it: she is the only girl.

grammar.point: 好 + 幾/多/些 + 量 — quite a few
grammar.explain: 好 before 幾/多/些 stresses that the number feels large: 好幾個孫子, 好多人, 好些朋友.

examples.id: My grandma has quite a few grandchildren.
My home is really lively!

grammar.explain: 其中 refers back to the group just mentioned: 有十個，其中三個是日本人 (there are ten, three of whom are Japanese).

examples.id: I'm the youngest of them.

check.q: Choose the right word: 我有五個朋友，＿＿兩個是臺灣人。

modules.title: 我姊姊快要結婚了！
modules.title_py: Wǒ jiě jie kuài yào jié hūn le!
modules.title_id: My sister is getting married soon!
modules.scene: Dawen announces that his older sister is about to marry her university classmate; he talks about his happy family.
can_do: Say 'soon' with 快要…了 and 就要…了
Talk about marriage & family: 結婚、父母、父親、母親
Give a name with 叫做 and the number of family members with 口
modules.exam_link: Life events (marriage, moving, births) SOMETIMES appear in 聽力 Part 2 and 閱讀 Part 4. 快要…了 matters for the order of events.

lines.zh: 美美，我姊姊快要結婚了！
lines.py: Měi měi, wǒ jiě jie kuài yào jié hūn le!
lines.id: Meimei, my sister's getting married soon!

lines.zh: 真的嗎？什麼時候？
lines.py: Zhēn de ma? Shén me shí hòu?
lines.id: Really? When?

lines.zh: 十二月。三天以後，我們一家人就要回印尼了。
lines.py: Shí èr yuè. Sān tiān yǐ hòu, wǒ men yì jiā rén jiù yào huí Yìn ní le.
lines.id: In December. In three days, my whole family is going back to Indonesia.

lines.zh: 你姊姊的先生帥不帥？
lines.py: Nǐ jiě jie de xiān shēng shuài bú shuài?
lines.id: Is your sister's fiancé handsome?

lines.zh: 很帥！他叫做小林。他們是大學的同班同學。
lines.py: Hěn shuài! Tā jiào zuò Xiǎo lín. Tā men shì dà xué de tóng bān tóng xué.
lines.id: Handsome! His name is Xiao Lin. They were classmates at university.

lines.zh: 你父母高興嗎？
lines.py: Nǐ fù mǔ gāo xìng ma?
lines.id: Are your parents happy?

lines.zh: 很高興！我父親說：「我的女兒快要結婚了！」我母親哭了。
lines.py: Hěn gāo xìng! Wǒ fù qīn shuō: "Wǒ de nǚ ér kuài yào jié hūn le!" Wǒ mǔ qīn kū le.
lines.id: Really happy! My dad said: 'My daughter's getting married soon!' My mum cried.

lines.zh: 你家有幾口人？
lines.py: Nǐ jiā yǒu jǐ kǒu rén?
lines.id: How many people are in your family?

lines.zh: 五口人。我外婆已經是老太太了，她也要來。
lines.py: Wǔ kǒu rén. Wǒ wài pó yǐ jīng shì lǎo tài tài le, tā yě yào lái.
lines.id: Five. My grandmother is very old, and she's coming too.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture. Listen to the question and answers A–C, then choose the answer that matches the picture.

picture.label: a train about to leave: the doors closing, the guard blowing a whistle

tasks.question: 火車怎麼樣？
tasks.why: Doors closing, whistle blowing → 快要開了. B: the train is still at the platform. C: the train is already here.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture. Listen to the question and answers A–C, then choose the answer that matches the picture.

picture.label: an older sister in a wedding dress

tasks.question: 你姊姊快要做什麼？
tasks.why: A wedding dress → 快要結婚了. A and B do not match the picture.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture. Listen to the question and answers A–C, then choose the answer that matches the picture.

picture.label: a handsome man striking a cool pose

tasks.question: 他怎麼樣？
tasks.why: A man striking a cool pose → 很帥. A and C are not shown.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 2 · One-turn question & answer
tasks.instr: Listen to the question, then choose the most suitable answer.
tasks.why: The question asks WHEN → 下個月就要結婚了. A and C give other details about the wedding, not the time.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 2 · One-turn question & answer
tasks.instr: Listen to the sentence, then choose the most suitable response.
tasks.why: 幾口人 = how many people in the family → 五口人. B says where they live; C gives news about the parents.

tasks.instr: Listen to the dialogue, then answer the question.

lines.zh: 我們快要上課了，你怎麼還在這裡？
今天不是星期六嗎？
今天星期五！明天才是星期六。
啊，我看錯日子了！

tasks.question: 今天星期幾？
tasks.why: 今天星期五. A is the day the man mistakenly thought it was. C is not mentioned.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 4 · Dialogue + implied meaning
tasks.instr: Listen to the dialogue, then choose the correct answer.

lines.zh: 你的同班同學小美下個月就要結婚了。
真的嗎？她才二十二歲啊！
對，她先生是她的大學同學。
那我要趕快去買東西送她了。

tasks.question: 這位小姐接著要做什麼？
tasks.why: 趕快去買東西送她 → buying a present for 小美. A is a misunderstanding. B and D are not mentioned.

tasks.instr: Read the sentence, then choose the matching picture.
tasks.text: 老太太笑著說：「我的孫女就要結婚了！」

options.label: grandma happy that her granddaughter is getting married

tasks.why: 老太太 + 笑著 + 孫女結婚 → a happy grandma. A has the wrong expression; B the wrong person (grandpa).

tasks.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the matching sentence.
tasks.why: A clock + a train ready to leave → 快要開了. A and C do not match.

tasks.part: 閱讀 Part 3 · Gap fill with picture
tasks.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the right word for the blank.
tasks.text: 我家有五（　）人。
tasks.why: The measure word for family members is 口 (五口人). 張 and 件 are for objects.

tasks.instr: Choose the right phrase for each blank. ONE option is not used.
tasks.text: 我姊姊（1）了，她的先生是她大學的（2）。他很（3），也對姊姊很好。我們家一共有五（4），加上他就是六個人了。下個星期我們（5），大家都很忙。
tasks.why: (1) 快要結婚了. (2) university classmates. (3) handsome. (4) 五口人 = five family members. (5) 就要…了 with a time: going home next week. 「叫做老太太」 fits no blank.

tasks.instr: Read the text, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 小林和美美是大學的同班同學，今年十二月就要結婚了。小林的父母住在高雄，美美的父母住在台北，所以他們要回兩個地方跟家人吃飯。美美說，她母親已經開始準備了，每天都很忙；她父親很少說話，可是晚上常常一個人看她小時候的照片。
tasks.question: 美美的父親為什麼常常看她小時候的照片？
options: 女兒快要結婚了，他有點難過
他在找結婚要用的照片
tasks.why: Quietly looking at childhood photos of the daughter who is about to marry → sad to 'let her go'. B and D are not mentioned. C: the house in 高雄 belongs to 小林's family, not his.

grammar.point: 就要…了 — (with a time) about to …
grammar.pattern: S + time + 就要 + V + 了
grammar.explain: 就要…了 = about to, and it CAN be preceded by a specific time expression: 三天以後就要回印尼了.

examples.zh: 三天以後，我們就要回印尼了。
examples.id: In three days we're going back to Indonesia.

grammar.explain: 快要…了 = soon (hasn't happened yet). It CANNOT be preceded by a specific time (明天快要… ✗) — use 就要 for that.

examples.id: My sister is getting married soon!
The train's about to leave.

core.meaning: child (in compounds: 兒子、孫子、孩子)

modules.title: 為了多一點零用錢，我去打工。
modules.title_py: Wèi le duō yì diǎn líng yòng qián, wǒ qù dǎ gōng.
modules.title_id: To get more pocket money, I work part-time.
modules.scene: Dawen works part-time at a coffee shop. He and Meimei talk about why they work, their ambitions, and helping their parents.
can_do: Express a purpose with 為了 (為了…，我…)
Do something instead of/for someone else: 替
Talk about part-time work & professions: 打工、工人、商人、教書
modules.exam_link: Purposes & reasons (為了) appear in 閱讀 Part 5 ('打工的目的是什麼？'). Professions are FREQUENT in 聽力 Parts 1–4.

lines.zh: 大文，你最近很忙嗎？
lines.py: Dà wén, nǐ zuì jìn hěn máng ma?
lines.id: Dawen, have you been busy lately?

lines.zh: 對，為了多一點零用錢，我去咖啡店打工。
lines.py: Duì, wèi le duō yì diǎn líng yòng qián, wǒ qù kā fēi diàn dǎ gōng.
lines.id: Yes — to get more pocket money, I'm working part-time at a coffee shop.

lines.zh: 你打工的目的只是錢嗎？
lines.py: Nǐ dǎ gōng de mù dì zhǐ shì qián ma?
lines.id: Is money your only reason for working?

lines.zh: 不只是錢，我也想練習中文。來喝咖啡的客人都是臺灣人。
lines.py: Bù zhǐ shì qián, wǒ yě xiǎng liàn xí Zhōng wén. Lái hē kā fēi de kè rén dōu shì Tái wān rén.
lines.id: Not only money — I also want to practise my Mandarin. The customers who come for coffee are all Taiwanese.

lines.zh: 美美，你以後想做什麼？
lines.py: Měi měi, nǐ yǐ hòu xiǎng zuò shén me?
lines.id: Meimei, what do you want to be in the future?

lines.zh: 我想教書。為了當老師，我每天很用功。
lines.py: Wǒ xiǎng jiāo shū. Wèi le dāng lǎo shī, wǒ měi tiān hěn yòng gōng.
lines.id: I want to teach. To become a teacher, I study hard every day.

lines.zh: 我爸爸是商人，我爺爺以前是工人。爸爸希望我以後也當商人……
lines.py: Wǒ bà ba shì shāng rén, wǒ yé ye yǐ qián shì gōng rén. Bà ba xī wàng wǒ yǐ hòu yě dāng shāng rén……
lines.id: My dad's a businessman, and my grandpa was a labourer. Dad hopes I'll be a businessman too…

lines.zh: 別想那麼多了！今天我替我媽媽去市場買菜，你要一起去嗎？
lines.py: Bié xiǎng nà me duō le! Jīn tiān wǒ tì wǒ mā ma qù shì chǎng mǎi cài, nǐ yào yì qǐ qù ma?
lines.id: Don't overthink it! Today I'm going to the market for my mum — want to come?

tasks.instr: Choose the right phrase for each blank. ONE option is not used.
tasks.text: 我爸爸是（1），常常去大陸工作。我媽媽在中學（2）。我上大學以後，（3），在一家餐廳打工。打工很累，可是我學到了很多。上個週末我生病了，我的同學（4）去餐廳工作。我打工的（5）不只是錢，也是為了多認識一些人。
tasks.why: (1) a businessman who often works in mainland China. (2) teaches at a middle school. (3) the reason for the part-time job. (4) a classmate covers for him. (5) 目的 = purpose. 「當工人」 does not fit any blank grammatically.

tasks.instr: Read the text, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 很多大學生都在打工。有的人是為了生活費，有的人是為了多學一點東西。我的朋友小王在一家公司打工，他說打工的目的不是錢，是想知道自己以後想不想做那樣的工作。我在書店打工，因為我很喜歡看書，也可以替老闆介紹好書給客人。
tasks.question: 小王為什麼去公司打工？
options: 他想知道自己以後想做什麼工作
tasks.why: 目的不是錢，是想知道…想不想做那樣的工作 → that is the reason. A: he says it is not about money. C is the writer's reason, not 小王's. D is not mentioned.

grammar.point: 為了 — for the sake of / in order to
grammar.explain: 為了 introduces a PURPOSE, usually at the start of the sentence, followed by the action taken to achieve it. Different from 因為 (reason/cause).

examples.zh: 為了多一點零用錢，我去打工。
examples.id: To get more pocket money, I work part-time.

examples.zh: 為了當老師，我每天很用功。
examples.id: To become a teacher, I study hard every day.

check.q: 'For the sake of his health, he runs every day' =

他每天跑步為了健康了。

grammar.explain: 替 + person = to do something instead of or for that person: 替媽媽去市場 (go to the market instead of mum).

examples.id: Today I'm going to the market for my mum.

can_do: Express strong obligation with 必須
Say 'no need' with 不用／不必
Talk about office work: 加班、開會、報告、要求
modules.exam_link: Office communication (meetings, reports, overtime) SOMETIMES appears in 聽力 Parts 3–4. 必須 vs 不必 is often the key to rule questions in 閱讀 Part 3.

lines.zh: 不必。公司的要求，你都做得很好。

lines.id: No need. You've done everything the company asked for well.

tasks.instr: Choose the right phrase for each blank. ONE option is not used.
tasks.text: 我在一家公司上班。最近公司很忙，我每天都（1），晚上十點才回家。上個星期，老闆（2）大家星期五以前必須寫完報告。我的報告寫了三天才寫完。星期五早上（3）的時候，老闆說我的報告寫得很好，他說：「這個週末你（4）。」我很高興，因為我（5）好好休息一下。
tasks.why: (1) working late every day. (2) the boss requires it. (3) during the meeting. (4) no need to come in at the weekend. (5) 必須好好休息 = really needs a good rest. 「很想打工」 fits no blank.

tasks.instr: Read these office rules, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 大文：明天早上九點要開會，我不能去，請你替我開會。開會的報告我已經寫好了，放在你的桌子上。開會以前你不必再看一次，可是老闆要求大家十點以前必須交報告，請你開完會就交給他。謝謝！——小林
tasks.question: 大文明天要做什麼？
options: 替小林開會，然後交報告
tasks.why: 請你替我開會 + 開完會就交給他. A: 小林 has already written the report. B: the meeting is at 9; 10 is the deadline for the report. D is not mentioned.

grammar.explain: 必須 = must, have to (stronger and more formal than 要). Its negative is NOT 不必須 but 不用 or 不必.

examples.id: I have to work overtime today.
I have to finish the report.

grammar.explain: 不用 (spoken) and 不必 (a little formal) = there's no need. Also used as short answers: 不必。／不用了。

examples.id: You don't need to work overtime today.
No need.

modules.title: 我對爬山很有興趣。
modules.title_py: Wǒ duì pá shān hěn yǒu xìng qù.
modules.title_id: I'm really interested in hiking.
modules.scene: Dawen and Meimei join a hobby club: they talk about their interests, then hike up Yangmingshan taking photos.
can_do: Express interest: 對 + thing + 有興趣
Express attitudes towards people: 對 + person + 很好
Talk about outdoor hobbies: 爬山、散步、拍照
modules.exam_link: Hobbies & interests are a FREQUENT topic in 聽力 Parts 1–2. The pattern 對…有興趣 is often the answer to 'what is he interested in?'.

lines.zh: 大文，你對什麼有興趣？
lines.py: Dà wén, nǐ duì shén me yǒu xìng qù?
lines.id: Dawen, what are you interested in?

lines.zh: 我對爬山很有興趣。你呢？
lines.py: Wǒ duì pá shān hěn yǒu xìng qù. Nǐ ne?
lines.id: I'm really interested in hiking. And you?

lines.zh: 我對拍照有興趣。我們可以一起去爬山，我在山上拍照。
lines.py: Wǒ duì pāi zhào yǒu xìng qù. Wǒ men kě yǐ yì qǐ qù pá shān, wǒ zài shān shàng pāi zhào.
lines.id: I'm interested in photography. We can hike together, and I'll take photos on the mountain.

lines.zh: 好！週末去陽明山吧！
lines.py: Hǎo! Zhōu mò qù Yáng míng shān ba!
lines.id: OK! Yangmingshan this weekend!

lines.zh: 美美，我們爬了兩個小時，我很累。
lines.py: Měi měi, wǒ men pá le liǎng ge xiǎo shí, wǒ hěn lèi.
lines.id: Meimei, we've been climbing for two hours — I'm tired.

lines.zh: 再走幾步就到了。到了山上，我們去散步吧。
lines.py: Zài zǒu jǐ bù jiù dào le. Dào le shān shàng, wǒ men qù sàn bù ba.
lines.id: Just a few more steps and we're there. At the top we can take a stroll.

lines.zh: 這裡的人對我們很好，給我們水喝。
lines.py: Zhè lǐ de rén duì wǒ men hěn hǎo, gěi wǒ men shuǐ hē.
lines.id: The people here are nice to us — they gave us water.

lines.zh: 你看，這裡的風景很美，我要拍很多相片！
lines.py: Nǐ kàn, zhè lǐ de fēng jǐng hěn měi, wǒ yào pāi hěn duō xiàng piàn!
lines.id: Look, the view is beautiful — I'm going to take loads of photos!

tasks.instr: Choose the right phrase for each blank. ONE option is not used.
tasks.text: 我對（1）很有興趣。上個週末，我跟朋友去陽明山。我們（2）了三個小時才到山上。我很累，朋友說：「（3）就到了，加油！」山上的風景很美，我拍了很多相片。山上的人（4），還給我們水喝。下山以後，我們在附近（5），然後才回家。
tasks.why: (1) his interest is mountain climbing. (2) climbed for three hours. (3) just a few more steps. (4) the people on the mountain are friendly. (5) a short stroll. 「對拍照沒有興趣」 contradicts the text: he took lots of photos.

tasks.instr: Read the text, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 我爸爸以前對運動沒有興趣，每天下班就坐在家裡看電視。去年醫生說他太胖了，要多走路。他就開始每天晚飯以後去公園散步。散步的時候他認識了幾個朋友，他們週末常常一起去爬山。現在我爸爸瘦多了，也對爬山越來越有興趣。
tasks.question: 爸爸為什麼開始散步？
tasks.why: 醫生說…要多走路 → that is the reason. A: his interest in climbing came later. C: he met his friends while walking. D is not mentioned.

grammar.explain: 對 + person + adjective expresses an attitude towards that person: 對我們很好 (nice to us), 對客人很客氣.

examples.id: The people here are nice to us.

grammar.pattern: S + 對 + thing + (很/沒)有興趣
grammar.explain: Interest is expressed with 對 + thing + 有興趣. Negative: 對…沒有興趣. Avoid 我有興趣爬山 (not quite right).

examples.id: I'm really interested in hiking.
I'm more interested in going for walks.

tasks.why: The audience is roaring with laughter → 有趣極了. A and C are the opposite.

tasks.question: 爸爸在做什麼？
tasks.why: Dad is watching the news on TV → 看新聞. A and B are other activities.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 2 · One-turn question & answer
tasks.instr: Listen to the question, then choose the most suitable answer.
options: 無聊極了，我不想再看了。
tasks.why: The question asks for an opinion → 無聊極了. A gives the place; C says who with.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 2 · One-turn question & answer
tasks.instr: Listen to the sentence, then choose the most suitable response.
options: 不太玩，我覺得有點無聊。
tasks.why: The question is how often → 不太玩. A says where it is; C talks about someone else.

tasks.instr: Listen to the dialogue, then answer the question.

lines.zh: 你喜歡看什麼電影？
我不太看電影，我比較喜歡看雜誌。
什麼雜誌？
旅行的雜誌，裡面的照片漂亮極了。

tasks.question: 這位小姐喜歡看什麼？
tasks.why: 比較喜歡看雜誌 → travel magazines. A: 不太看電影. C is not mentioned.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 4 · Dialogue + implied meaning
tasks.instr: Listen to the dialogue, then choose the correct answer.

lines.zh: 你玩了那個新的遊戲嗎？大家都說有趣極了。
我玩了一次，覺得不太有意思。
真的嗎？我還想買呢。
那你玩我的吧，覺得好玩以後再去買。

tasks.question: 這位小姐的意思是什麼？
options: 這位先生可以玩她的遊戲
大家都覺得遊戲很無聊
tasks.why: 那你玩我的吧 → she offers her game first. A is the opposite (不太有意思). C is not mentioned. D is the opposite (大家都說有趣極了).

tasks.instr: Read the sentence, then choose the matching picture.
tasks.text: 弟弟覺得這個遊戲好玩得不得了，玩了一個下午。

options.label: a child bored with a game
a child absorbed in a game

tasks.why: 好玩得不得了 → great fun. A is the opposite; C is a different activity.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the matching sentence.
tasks.why: The TV is showing the news → 看電視新聞. B and C do not match.

tasks.part: 閱讀 Part 3 · Gap fill with picture
tasks.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the right word for the blank.
tasks.text: 今天熱（　）了，我不想出去。
tasks.why: Vs極了 = extremely. 熱很了 and 熱太了 have the wrong word order (很熱, 太熱了).

tasks.instr: Choose the right phrase for each blank. ONE option is not used.
tasks.text: 上個週末我跟朋友去（1）看電影。朋友說那部電影（2），可是我看了半個小時就覺得（3）。電影結束以後，我們去書店，朋友買了兩本（4）。回家以後，我在手機上看（5），才知道明天會熱得不得了。
tasks.why: (1) the cinema. (2) his friend thought it was great fun. (3) but he found it boring. (4) bought magazines at the bookshop. (5) learned tomorrow's weather from the news. 「不太玩遊戲」 fits no blank.

tasks.instr: Read the text, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 現在很多年輕人不看電視新聞，也不買雜誌，他們用手機看新聞。我爺爺覺得這樣不好，他說手機上的新聞太短，看了也不太清楚。可是我覺得手機很方便，在公車上也能看。我們家每天吃晚飯的時候，爺爺看電視新聞，我看手機新聞，大家都不說話，無聊極了。
tasks.question: 這個人覺得晚飯的時候怎麼樣？
options: 大家都在看新聞，很無聊
tasks.why: 大家都不說話，無聊極了. A is the opposite (不說話). B is not mentioned. D: only grandpa watches TV.

grammar.point: Vs極了／Vs得不得了／Vs得很 — extremely
grammar.pattern: Vs + 極了 ／ Vs + 得 + 不得了/很
grammar.explain: Three ways to intensify an adjective AFTER it: 有趣極了, 熱得不得了, 好玩得很 — all 'extremely'. Not used together with 很 in front (很有趣極了 ✗).

examples.id: This film's really fun!
Tomorrow will be extremely hot.

grammar.explain: 不太 (more common) / 不很 = not very, a gentle way of giving a negative judgement. Compare: 很不好 (very bad) is much harsher.

examples.id: American films aren't very interesting.
Not much.

modules.title: 我們先去參觀，再去逛夜市。
modules.title_py: Wǒ men xiān qù cān guān, zài qù guàng yè shì.
modules.title_id: Let's visit the museum first, then go to the night market.
modules.scene: A plan for a day off: visiting the National Palace Museum, then strolling round the night market, eating and watching street performances.
can_do: Put plans in order: 先…再…
Express two simultaneous activities: 一邊…一邊…
Talk about sightseeing visits: 參觀、逛、訂、假日
modules.exam_link: Schedules & the order of activities (先…再…) often appear in 聽力 Part 3 ('what do they do first?') and 閱讀 Part 3.

lines.zh: 大文，這個假日我們去哪裡玩？
lines.py: Dà wén, zhè ge jià rì wǒ men qù nǎ lǐ wán?
lines.id: Dawen, where shall we go on our day off?

lines.zh: 我們先去故宮參觀，再去逛夜市。
lines.py: Wǒ men xiān qù Gù gōng cān guān, zài qù guàng yè shì.
lines.id: Let's visit the Palace Museum first, then go to the night market.

lines.zh: 好！我要先訂票。故宮有很多有名畫家的畫。
lines.py: Hǎo! Wǒ yào xiān dìng piào. Gù gōng yǒu hěn duō yǒu míng huà jiā de huà.
lines.id: OK! I'll book the tickets first. The Palace Museum has lots of paintings by famous painters.

lines.zh: 我們一邊逛一邊吃吧！
lines.py: Wǒ men yì biān guàng yì biān chī ba!
lines.id: Let's eat while we walk around!

lines.zh: 好。你看，那邊有人一邊唱歌一邊跳舞。
lines.py: Hǎo. Nǐ kàn, nà biān yǒu rén yì biān chàng gē yì biān tiào wǔ.
lines.id: OK. Look, there's someone over there singing and dancing at the same time.

lines.zh: 那個舞很好看！他可以同時做兩件事。
lines.py: Nà ge wǔ hěn hǎo kàn! Tā kě yǐ tóng shí zuò liǎng jiàn shì.
lines.id: The dancing's great! She can do two things at once.

lines.zh: 假日的夜市到處都是人！
lines.py: Jià rì de yè shì dào chù dōu shì rén!
lines.id: The night market on a day off is packed with people everywhere!

tasks.instr: Look at the picture. Listen to the question and answers A–C, then choose the answer that matches the picture.
tasks.question: 她在做什麼？
options: 她一邊唱歌一邊吃東西。
tasks.why: Singing and dancing at the same time → 一邊唱歌一邊跳舞. A: she is the one dancing. B: there is no food.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture. Listen to the question and answers A–C, then choose the answer that matches the picture.

picture.label: he is doing his homework while listening to music

tasks.question: 她在做什麼？
options: 一邊看電視，一邊寫作業。
一邊聽音樂，一邊寫作業。
她在聽音樂，沒有寫作業。
tasks.why: Doing homework while listening to music → 一邊聽音樂，一邊寫作業. A: there is no TV. C: she is writing.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture. Listen to the question and answers A–C, then choose the answer that matches the picture.

picture.label: a day off, strolling round the night market

tasks.question: 假日你喜歡做什麼？
tasks.why: Wandering round a night market → 逛夜市. A and B do not match the picture.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 2 · One-turn question & answer
tasks.instr: Listen to the question, then choose the most suitable answer.
options: 我想先去參觀，再去逛夜市。
tasks.why: The question asks about plans → 先去參觀，再去逛夜市. A talks about last week; C is a general comment.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 2 · One-turn question & answer
tasks.instr: Listen to the sentence, then choose the most suitable response.
tasks.audio: 我們先吃飯，再去看電影，好嗎？
tasks.why: An invitation with a 先…再 order → 好啊. B comments on the film; C does not respond to the invitation.

tasks.instr: Listen to the dialogue, then answer the question.

lines.zh: 我們今天先去哪裡？
先去故宮參觀，然後吃午飯。
可是我好餓，我們先吃飯再去參觀，好不好？
好吧，那就先吃飯。

tasks.question: 他們今天先做什麼？
tasks.why: Her suggestion is accepted: 先吃飯. A was the original plan, now changed. C is not mentioned.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 4 · Dialogue + implied meaning
tasks.instr: Listen to the dialogue, then choose the correct answer.

lines.zh: 聽說故宮週末人很多，我們星期五去吧。
星期五我要上班。
那星期六早上一開門就去，先參觀，再吃午飯。
好，那我今天就先訂票。

tasks.question: 他們什麼時候去故宮？
tasks.why: 星期六早上一開門就去. A is ruled out (she works). C: midday is for lunch. D: today they only book tickets.

tasks.instr: Read the sentence, then choose the matching picture.
tasks.text: 他們先參觀了故宮，再去夜市吃東西。
tasks.why: 先故宮，再夜市 → the museum first, then the night market. A is in the wrong order; C is incomplete.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the matching sentence.

picture.label: a night market packed with people

tasks.why: Packed with people → 到處都是人. A and B are the opposite.

tasks.part: 閱讀 Part 3 · Gap fill with picture
tasks.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the right word for the blank.
tasks.text: 下個星期的票很多人買，我們今天就要先（　）票。
tasks.why: 訂票 = book tickets. 逛 and 參觀 do not go with 票.

tasks.instr: Choose the right phrase for each blank. ONE option is not used.
tasks.text: 我很喜歡參觀，每個（1）都去不同的地方。上個週末，我先在網路上（2），然後才去故宮看畫。那個（3）的畫很有名，參觀的人很多，（4）都是人。參觀完以後，我跟朋友去逛夜市，（5），吃了很多小吃。
tasks.why: (1) every holiday. (2) book tickets first (先…然後). (3) a famous painter. (4) 到處都是人 = people everywhere. (5) strolling and eating. 「同時跳舞」 fits no blank.

tasks.instr: Read this plan, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 這個假日，我跟朋友在台北玩。第一天我們先去參觀故宮，看了很多有名畫家的畫。晚上我們去逛夜市，一邊吃一邊逛，到處都是人。第二天我們想去爬山，可是下雨了，就在旅館休息了一天。
tasks.question: 他們第二天為什麼沒去爬山？
tasks.why: 可是下雨了 → bad weather. A is not mentioned. B and D were on the first day.

grammar.explain: 先 marks the first activity, 再 the next one (usually future plans). Different from 然後 (C12), which is more neutral, for telling stories.

examples.zh: 我們先去故宮參觀，再去逛夜市。
examples.id: Let's go to the Palace Museum first, then the night market.

grammar.pattern: S + 一邊 + V1 + 一邊 + V2
grammar.explain: Two activities done at the SAME time by the same person: 一邊逛一邊吃 (eat while walking around).

examples.id: Let's eat while we walk around!

check.q: 'He drinks coffee while reading the newspaper' =
options: 他一邊喝咖啡一邊看報紙。
他一邊喝咖啡看報紙一邊。
一邊他喝咖啡一邊看報紙。

modules.title: 搭捷運去比較快。
modules.title_py: Dā jié yùn qù bǐ jiào kuài.
modules.title_id: The MRT is faster.
modules.scene: Dawen and Meimei take the MRT into the city centre: going in through the entrance, waiting on the platform, and getting out at the right exit.
can_do: Combine means and purpose: 搭捷運去 + place
Use 到 as 'to arrive' (到了、快到了)
Read MRT signs: 月台、入口、出口、班次、座位
modules.exam_link: Public transport (MRT, platforms, exits) is a FREQUENT topic in 聽力 Parts 1–3 and 閱讀 Parts 1–3 (signs & timetables).

lines.zh: 美美，我們怎麼去市區？
lines.py: Měi měi, wǒ men zěn me qù shì qū?
lines.id: Meimei, how shall we get to the city centre?

lines.zh: 搭捷運去比較快。
lines.py: Dā jié yùn qù bǐ jiào kuài.
lines.id: The MRT is faster.

lines.zh: 臺灣的捷運跟雅加達的地鐵一樣嗎？
lines.py: Tái wān de jié yùn gēn Yǎ jiā dá de dì tiě yí yàng ma?
lines.id: Is Taiwan's MRT the same as Jakarta's underground?

lines.zh: 差不多。我們從這個入口進去吧。
lines.py: Chà bù duō. Wǒ men cóng zhè ge rù kǒu jìn qù ba.
lines.id: Similar. Let's go in through this entrance.

lines.zh: 月台上人好多！
lines.py: Yuè tái shàng rén hǎo duō!
lines.id: There are so many people on the platform!

lines.zh: 沒關係，班次很多，五分鐘就有一班。
lines.py: Méi guān xi, bān cì hěn duō, wǔ fēn zhōng jiù yǒu yì bān.
lines.id: It's fine — trains are frequent, every five minutes.

lines.zh: 車上有座位嗎？
lines.py: Chē shàng yǒu zuò wèi ma?
lines.id: Are there seats on the train?

lines.zh: 沒有，我們站著吧。你看，到了！我們從三號出口出去，可以直接到百貨公司。
lines.py: Méi yǒu, wǒ men zhàn zhe ba. Nǐ kàn, dào le! Wǒ men cóng sān hào chū kǒu chū qù, kě yǐ zhí jiē dào bǎi huò gōng sī.
lines.id: No, let's just stand. Look, we're here! Take exit 3 and you can go straight to the department store.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture. Listen to the question and answers A–C, then choose the answer that matches the picture.
tasks.question: 從幾號出口出去？
tasks.why: The sign points to exit 2 → 二號. A and C are other numbers.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture. Listen to the question and answers A–C, then choose the answer that matches the picture.

picture.label: taking the MRT at an underground platform

tasks.question: 你怎麼去上班？
tasks.why: An underground MRT platform → 搭捷運. A and C are other transport.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture. Listen to the question and answers A–C, then choose the answer that matches the picture.

picture.label: a sign: the exit is on the right

tasks.question: 出口在哪裡？
tasks.why: The sign points right → 右邊. B is the other way; C does not match.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 2 · One-turn question & answer
tasks.instr: Listen to the question, then choose the most suitable answer.
tasks.why: 怎麼去 = how (by what) → 搭捷運去. A says where it is; C gives a time.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 2 · One-turn question & answer
tasks.instr: Listen to the sentence, then choose the most suitable response.
tasks.why: The question is when the next train comes → 五分鐘以後. A and B give no time.

tasks.instr: Listen to the dialogue, then answer the question.

lines.zh: 我們搭捷運去百貨公司吧。
好，從哪個出口出去？
二號出口人太多，我們從三號出口出去吧，也可以直接到百貨公司。
好，聽你的。

tasks.question: 他們要從幾號出口出去？
tasks.why: 從三號出口出去. A is mentioned but too crowded. C is not mentioned.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 4 · Dialogue + implied meaning
tasks.instr: Listen to the dialogue, then choose the correct answer.

lines.zh: 我們坐公車去還是搭捷運去？
公車站比較近，可是現在是下班時間。
那公車一定很慢。
對，我們走遠一點，去搭捷運吧。

tasks.question: 他們為什麼不坐公車？
tasks.why: 下班時間 → 公車一定很慢. A is the opposite (公車站比較近). C and D are not mentioned.

tasks.instr: Read the sentence, then choose the matching picture.
tasks.text: 月台上人很多，大家都在等車。

options.label: a platform full of people waiting

tasks.why: 月台 + 人很多 + 等車. A is the opposite; C is already on the train.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the matching sentence.
tasks.why: Empty seats → 還有座位. B and C are the opposite.

tasks.part: 閱讀 Part 3 · Gap fill with picture
tasks.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the right word for the blank.
tasks.text: 我們（　）捷運去市區吧。
tasks.why: 搭捷運 = take the MRT. 騎 is for bikes/scooters; 走 is not followed by a vehicle.

tasks.instr: Choose the right phrase for each blank. ONE option is not used.
tasks.text: 我第一次在台北（1）。我從入口進去，買了票，然後到（2）等車。班次很多，（3）就來了一班。車上人很多，沒有（4）。二十分鐘以後，我到了。我從五號出口出去，（5）到了公司。
tasks.why: (1) take the MRT. (2) wait on the platform. (3) a train every five minutes. (4) no seats. (5) straight to the office. 「坐飛機去」 fits no blank.

tasks.instr: Read this MRT information, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 台北的捷運很方便，班次也很多，一般五分鐘就有一班。可是早上七點到九點，上班的人很多，月台上到處都是人，車上也常常沒有座位。所以我每天早上六點半就出門，這個時候搭捷運，一定有座位。
tasks.question: 這個人為什麼六點半就出門？
tasks.why: 這個時候搭捷運，一定有座位 → that is the reason. A and C are not mentioned. D: the problem is crowds from 7 to 9, not the number of trains.

grammar.explain: Two verb phrases in a row with no linking word: the first is the means, the second the purpose/direction: 搭捷運去市區, 去夜市吃東西. The order follows the order of events.

examples.id: Taking the MRT (there) is faster.

grammar.pattern: S + 到 + (place) + 了 ／ 快到了
grammar.explain: 到 as a verb = to arrive: 到了 (we're here), 快到了 (almost there), 到台北 (arrive in Taipei).

examples.id: Look, we're here!
Two more stops and we're there.

modules.title: 我騎不了機車。
modules.title_py: Wǒ qí bù liǎo jī chē.
modules.title_id: I can't ride a scooter.
modules.scene: Meimei asks whether Dawen can ride a scooter like most Taiwanese people. They talk about traffic, parking and speed on the roads.
can_do: Say whether you are able to: V得了／V不了
Say whether a result is possible: V得/不 + result (聽得懂、看不清楚)
Talk about traffic: 機車、停車場、公路、速度、交通
modules.exam_link: Potential forms (聽得懂/聽不懂、吃得了/吃不了) appear very often in 聽力 Parts 2–4 and are distractors in 閱讀 Part 4.

lines.zh: 大文，你會騎機車嗎？
lines.py: Dà wén, nǐ huì qí jī chē ma?
lines.id: Dawen, can you ride a scooter?

lines.zh: 我騎不了機車，臺灣的交通太亂了。
lines.py: Wǒ qí bù liǎo jī chē, Tái wān de jiāo tōng tài luàn le.
lines.id: I can't ride a scooter — Taiwan's traffic is too chaotic.

lines.zh: 臺灣的摩托車真多！
lines.py: Tái wān de mó tuō chē zhēn duō!
lines.id: There are so many scooters in Taiwan!

lines.zh: 我騎自行車就好。
lines.py: Wǒ qí zì xíng chē jiù hǎo.
lines.id: I'll just ride a bicycle.

lines.zh: 公路上的速度很快，你要小心。
lines.py: Gōng lù shàng de sù dù hěn kuài, nǐ yào xiǎo xīn.
lines.id: The speed on the highway is high — you have to be careful.

lines.zh: 機車可以停在哪裡？
lines.py: Jī chē kě yǐ tíng zài nǎ lǐ?
lines.id: Where can scooters be parked?

lines.zh: 停在停車場。這裡不能停。
lines.py: Tíng zài tíng chē chǎng. Zhè lǐ bù néng tíng.
lines.id: In the car park. You can't park here.

lines.zh: 你說得很清楚，我都聽得懂。你的中文很標準，我也想說得跟你一樣好！
lines.py: Nǐ shuō de hěn qīng chǔ, wǒ dōu tīng de dǒng. Nǐ de Zhōng wén hěn biāo zhǔn, wǒ yě xiǎng shuō de gēn nǐ yí yàng hǎo!
lines.id: You speak clearly — I understand everything. Your Mandarin is very standard; I want to speak as well as you!

tasks.question: 這裡能停機車嗎？
tasks.why: A no-scooter-parking sign → 不能停. A and C are the opposite.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture. Listen to the question and answers A–C, then choose the answer that matches the picture.

tasks.question: 你騎得了機車嗎？
tasks.why: He almost falls off the scooter → 騎不了. A is the opposite; C: the scooter is in the picture.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture. Listen to the question and answers A–C, then choose the answer that matches the picture.
tasks.question: 車停在哪裡？
tasks.why: Cars in a car park → 停車場. A and B are other places.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 2 · One-turn question & answer
tasks.instr: Listen to the question, then choose the most suitable answer.
tasks.audio: 這麼多菜，你一個人吃得了嗎？
tasks.why: 吃得了嗎 = can you finish it all? → 吃不了. A comments on the taste; C does not fit.

tasks.instr: Choose the right phrase for each blank. ONE option is not used.
tasks.text: 我朋友從印尼來臺灣念書。他說臺灣的（1）太亂了，公路上到處都是（2）。有一次他想騎機車，可是他（3），所以還是騎（4）。他說老師的中文很（5），他都聽得懂。
tasks.why: (1) chaotic traffic. (2) scooters everywhere. (3) couldn't manage a scooter. (4) so rode a bicycle. (5) the teacher's Chinese is standard/clear. 「停車場」 fits no blank.

tasks.instr: Read this parking sign, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 在臺灣，很多人騎機車上班，因為機車很方便，停車也比較容易。可是公路上的機車太多了，速度也很快，交通常常很亂。我剛來臺灣的時候，一看到那麼多機車就很緊張。所以我買了一輛自行車，每天騎自行車去學校。自行車比較慢，可是我騎的時候一點也不緊張。
tasks.question: 這個人為什麼騎自行車？
tasks.why: 看到機車就很緊張 + 騎自行車不緊張 → that is the reason. A and C are not mentioned. D is the opposite.

grammar.explain: 得了/不了 (liǎo) after a verb = able or unable (because of ability/circumstances): 騎不了 (can't ride), 吃得了嗎？ (can you finish it?).

examples.id: I can't ride a scooter.
With this much food, can you finish it?

check.q: 'I won't be able to come tomorrow' =

grammar.point: V得/不 + result — can/can't (achieve a result)
grammar.pattern: V + 得/不 + result (懂/清楚/到…)
grammar.explain: 得 or 不 is inserted between a verb and its result to express possibility: 聽得懂 (can understand), 看不清楚 (can't see clearly), 找不到 (can't find).

examples.id: I understand everything.

supplement.meaning: can; to be able to (more formal than 能)

modules.title: 我明天才出國。
modules.title_py: Wǒ míng tiān cái chū guó.
modules.title_id: I'm not going abroad until tomorrow.
modules.scene: Dawen gets ready to go back to Indonesia for his sister's wedding: the visa has only just come through, he doesn't have enough suitcases, and then he arrives and talks about the time difference.
can_do: Say 'not until (later than expected)': 才1 (明天才出國)
Say 'only (a little)': 才4 (才一個小時)
Talk about international travel: 出國、簽證、行李、時差
modules.exam_link: 才 vs 就 (later vs earlier than expected) is one of the most frequent distractors in 聽力 Part 4.

lines.zh: 大文，你今天出國嗎？
lines.py: Dà wén, nǐ jīn tiān chū guó ma?
lines.id: Dawen, are you going abroad today?

lines.zh: 不，我明天才出國。簽證昨天才拿到。
lines.py: Bù, wǒ míng tiān cái chū guó. Qiān zhèng zuó tiān cái ná dào.
lines.id: No, I'm not leaving until tomorrow. I only got my visa yesterday.

lines.zh: 你的行李準備了嗎？
lines.py: Nǐ de xíng lǐ zhǔn bèi le ma?
lines.id: Is your luggage ready?

lines.zh: 還沒。我才有一個箱子，不夠。
lines.py: Hái méi. Wǒ cái yǒu yí ge xiāng zi, bú gòu.
lines.id: Not yet. I only have one suitcase — it's not enough.

lines.zh: 美美，我到印尼了！
lines.py: Měi měi, wǒ dào Yìn ní le!
lines.id: Meimei, I've arrived in Indonesia!

lines.zh: 時差是幾個小時？
lines.py: Shí chā shì jǐ ge xiǎo shí?
lines.id: How many hours' time difference is there?

lines.zh: 才一個小時。
lines.py: Cái yí ge xiǎo shí.
lines.id: Only one hour.

lines.zh: 你要在印尼留多久？
lines.py: Nǐ yào zài Yìn ní liú duō jiǔ?
lines.id: How long will you stay in Indonesia?

lines.zh: 留兩個星期。
lines.py: Liú liǎng ge xīng qí.
lines.id: Two weeks.

lines.zh: 你的簽證拿到了嗎？
昨天才拿到，後天就要出國了。
那你的行李準備好了嗎？
還沒，我今天晚上才開始準備。

tasks.question: 哪一個是對的？
options: 這位先生還沒拿到簽證
這位先生很晚才準備出國的東西
這位先生的行李準備好了
tasks.why: The visa only came yesterday and the packing only starts tonight (才 = late) → last-minute preparations. A is the opposite. B: he leaves the day after tomorrow (後天). D is the opposite (還沒).

tasks.instr: Read the sentence, then choose the matching picture.
tasks.text: 他才有一個箱子，可是東西太多了。

options.label: one suitcase but lots of things

tasks.why: 才一個箱子 + 東西太多 → one suitcase, things piled up. A has the wrong number of suitcases; C has few things.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the matching sentence.
tasks.why: Immigration documents → 簽證. A and B are luggage.

tasks.part: 閱讀 Part 3 · Gap fill with picture
tasks.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the right word for the blank.
tasks.text: 臺灣和日本的（　）是一個小時。
tasks.why: 一個小時 → 時差 (time difference). 行李 and 簽證 are not measured in hours.

tasks.instr: Choose the right phrase for each blank. ONE option is not used.
tasks.text: 下個月我要去日本念書，我昨天（1）拿到簽證。我要在日本（2）一年，所以要帶很多（3）。可是我（4）有兩個箱子，不夠，還要再買一個。日本跟臺灣的（5）是一個小時，所以不會太累。
tasks.why: (1) 才 = only (late). (2) stay a year. (3) lots of luggage. (4) only two suitcases. (5) a one-hour time difference. 「出國了」 fits no blank.

tasks.instr: Read the text, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 很多人第一次出國，只準備了簽證和行李，可是忘了時差的問題。我去年去美國念書，那裡跟臺灣的時差是十二個小時。第一個星期，我晚上兩點還不想睡覺，白天上課一直想睡覺。一個星期以後才好一點。
tasks.question: 這個人去美國第一個星期怎麼了？
options: 因為時差，白天很想睡覺
他每天晚上很早就睡覺
tasks.why: A 12-hour time difference → sleepy in the daytime. A: what was forgotten is the time difference, not the visa. C is not mentioned. D is the opposite (still not sleepy at 2 a.m.).

grammar.explain: 才 after a time expression = not until (late/later than hoped): 明天才出國, 半夜兩點才睡覺. Sentences with 才 usually DON'T use 了. The opposite: 就 (earlier).

examples.id: I'm not leaving until tomorrow.
I only got my visa yesterday.

grammar.explain: 才 before a number = only, stressing that the amount is small: 才一個小時, 我才有一個箱子.

examples.id: Only one hour.
I only have one suitcase.

modules.title: 票都賣完了，我們只好坐船。
modules.title_py: Piào dōu mài wán le, wǒ men zhǐ hǎo zuò chuán.
modules.title_id: The tickets are sold out, so we have to take the boat.

Talk about full bookings: 客滿、賣完了、利用假日
modules.exam_link: Plans that change because tickets sell out/the weather appear in 聽力 Part 4 ('how did they go in the end?'). 只好 marks the last resort.

dialogs.title_id: In front of the travel agency

lines.zh: 美美，去綠島的飛機票都賣完了！客滿了。
lines.py: Měi měi, qù Lǜ dǎo de fēi jī piào dōu mài wán le! Kè mǎn le.
lines.id: Meimei, the plane tickets to Lüdao are sold out! It's fully booked.

lines.zh: 好。不管坐什麼，我都想去！
lines.py: Hǎo. Bù guǎn zuò shén me, wǒ dōu xiǎng qù!

lines.zh: 船也客滿了嗎？

lines.id: Is the boat full too?

lines.zh: 還有兩張票，可是很貴。
lines.py: Hái yǒu liǎng zhāng piào, kě shì hěn guì.
