lines.zh: 不管多貴，我們都要買！
lines.py: Bù guǎn duō guì, wǒ men dōu yào mǎi!
lines.id: No matter how expensive they are, we'll buy them!

lines.zh: 對！我們要好好利用這個假日！
lines.py: Duì! Wǒ men yào hǎo hǎo lì yòng zhè ge jià rì!
lines.id: Right! We have to make the most of this holiday!

tasks.why: Rain → stuck at home: 只好. 不管 needs 都; 利用 needs an object.

tasks.instr: Choose the right phrase for each blank. ONE option is not used.
tasks.text: 上個週末我們想去綠島，可是飛機票都賣完了，（1）。我們只好（2）。坐船要一個小時，我有一點不舒服，可是（3），我都想去。到了綠島，我們（4）這兩天的時間，去了很多地方。回來的時候，船也（5），可是我們早就買了票，所以沒問題。
tasks.why: (1) the plane is full. (2) have to take the boat. (3) 不管…都 = still want to go no matter what. (4) make good use of two days. (5) the boat back is full. 「只好坐飛機」 contradicts the text: plane tickets were sold out.

tasks.instr: Read this notice, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 這個夏天我想去日本玩，可是飛機票太貴了，飯店也都客滿了。我只好在臺灣玩。我利用這兩個星期，坐火車去了花蓮和臺南。沒有出國，可是我覺得在臺灣玩也很有意思。
tasks.question: 這個人為什麼沒有去日本？
options: 飛機票太貴，飯店也客滿了
tasks.why: 飛機票太貴 + 飯店客滿 → that is the reason. A is the opposite (他想去). C: he had two weeks. D: he went to Hualien on holiday.

grammar.point: 不管…都… — no matter what/how …, still …
grammar.pattern: 不管 + (question word/A不A)…，S + 都 + VP
grammar.explain: 不管 is followed by a question word (什麼/多/誰) or an A不A form, then 都 in the second clause: the outcome doesn't change under any condition.

examples.id: However we get there, I still want to go!
No matter how expensive they are, we'll buy them!

grammar.point: 只好 — have no choice but to
grammar.explain: 只好 = there's no other option but …: 票賣完了，我們只好坐船. It is usually preceded by the reason.

examples.id: Then we'll have to take the boat.

modules.title: 要是颱風來了，就不去溫泉了。
modules.title_py: Yào shì tái fēng lái le, jiù bú qù wēn quán le.
modules.title_id: If the typhoon comes, we won't go to the hot spring.
modules.scene: Meimei suggests going to a hot spring in Beitou, but the news forecasts a typhoon. They make a conditional plan.
can_do: Make hypotheses: 要是…就…、…的話
Understand weather news: 颱風、中心、方向、度
Talk about locations & estimates: 地點、大概
modules.exam_link: Typhoon news & conditional plans are a typically Taiwanese context in 聽力 Part 4 and 閱讀 Part 5.

lines.zh: 大文，週末我們去溫泉吧！

lines.zh: 新聞說颱風大概週末會來。

lines.id: The news says the typhoon will probably come this weekend.

lines.zh: 要是颱風來了，就不去溫泉了。

lines.zh: 在臺灣的南方，方向是往北部。

lines.id: It's south of Taiwan, heading towards the north.

lines.zh: 溫泉的地點在哪裡？
lines.py: Wēn quán de dì diǎn zài nǎ lǐ?
lines.id: Where's the hot spring?

lines.zh: 在北投。春季去溫泉最好。現在二十度，不冷也不熱。
lines.py: Zài Běi tóu. Chūn jì qù wēn quán zuì hǎo. Xiàn zài èr shí dù, bù lěng yě bú rè.
lines.id: In Beitou. Spring is the best time to go to a hot spring. It's 20 degrees now — not cold, not hot.

lines.zh: 我們可以去溫泉。下雨的話，我們就不去了。
lines.py: Wǒ men kě yǐ qù wēn quán. Xià yǔ de huà, wǒ men jiù bú qù le.
lines.id: We can go to the hot springs. If it rains, we won't go.

modules.title: 媽媽讓我去陪奶奶。

modules.title_id: My mum told me to keep my grandma company.
modules.scene: Meimei's grandmother is ill; her mother asks Meimei to keep her company and look after her at the weekend. Her grandchild's visit makes her grandmother happy.

modules.exam_link: 讓 has two meanings (to make/let someone do vs to make someone feel) — often tested in 聽力 Part 4 and 閱讀 Part 4.

lines.zh: 大文，這個週末我不能出去，媽媽讓我去陪奶奶。

lines.py: Nǎi nai shēng bìng le, wǒ men yào zhào gù tā.

lines.zh: 不，他陪我去。
lines.py: Bù, tā péi wǒ qù.
lines.id: No, he's coming with me.

lines.zh: 奶奶說：「你們來看我，讓我很高興。」
lines.py: Nǎi nai shuō: "Nǐ men lái kàn wǒ, ràng wǒ hěn gāo xìng."

lines.zh: 你跟奶奶的關係很好。
lines.py: Nǐ gēn nǎi nai de guān xì hěn hǎo.
lines.id: You're really close to your grandma.

lines.zh: 對，我小時候奶奶一直在我身邊。
lines.py: Duì, wǒ xiǎo shí hòu nǎi nai yì zhí zài wǒ shēn biān.
lines.id: Yes, when I was little Grandma was always by my side.

tasks.text: 上個月我外公生病了，在醫院住了兩個星期。媽媽每天下班以後都去（1）他。週末媽媽（2）我也去醫院。外公看到我來，說：「你來看我，（3）！」醫院的護士對外公很好，常常（4）他的身體。現在外公回家了，我們都想常常在他（5）。

tasks.text: 昨天晚上我給朋友（1）了一個簡訊，可是他一直沒回。今天我問他，他說：「對不起，我昨天（2），沒聽見手機。」我說：「你（3）呢！」他笑著說：「別（4）了。」然後他告訴我一個好（5）：我們的報告拿了第一名。
tasks.why: (1) sent a message. (2) wearing earphones, so didn't hear. (3) 真 + Vs: 真忙. (4) 別開玩笑了. (5) good news. 「有禮貌」 fits no blank.

tasks.instr: Read this message, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 上個星期我們班做了一個報告，我跟小林、安安合作。小林很會說話，安安很會寫，我做照片。我們每天晚上用手機傳簡訊談報告的事。報告的時候，老師說我們合作得很好，也很有禮貌。我覺得，一個人做得好不難，大家一起做得好比較難。
tasks.question: 這個人覺得什麼比較難？
tasks.why: 大家一起做得好比較難. A, B and D are not described as hard.

grammar.explain: 真 + adjective = an exclamation, 'so/really …!': 你真忙！ Only for exclamations/predicates — not used before 的 + noun (真好的人 ✗, use 很好的人).

examples.id: You're so busy!
You really care about your grandma!

grammar.explain: 呢 at the end of a STATEMENT insists or corrects what the other person assumes, like 'you know/actually': 我傳簡訊給你了呢！ (I did send you a message, you know!). Different from 呢1 (B04) in questions.

examples.id: I did send you a message!
It's true, you know!

tasks.why: 被 + V掉了 = eaten up by … 吃得了 and 吃好了 do not fit this 被 sentence.

tasks.instr: Choose the right phrase for each blank. ONE option is not used.
tasks.text: 昨天下午我去打籃球，打了兩個小時，（1），衣服都溼了。晚上我開始（2），一直咳嗽，也（3）。今天早上我去看醫生，醫生說不太（4），多喝水、多休息就好了。我桌上的麵包（5），我只好喝牛奶。
tasks.why: (1) sweated a lot. (2) started running a fever. (3) runny nose. (4) not very serious. (5) 被…吃掉了 = eaten by his roommate. 「頭痛得很好」 makes no sense.

tasks.instr: Read the text, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 上個星期弟弟感冒了，後來我也感冒了。我一直咳嗽、流鼻水，晚上也常常頭痛。醫生給了我一些藥，說一天吃三次。可是第三天我找不到藥了，問了媽媽才知道，是被弟弟吃掉了，他以為那是他的藥。媽媽只好再帶我去看醫生。
tasks.question: 為什麼媽媽又帶他去看醫生？
tasks.why: 藥被弟弟吃掉了 → the medicine was gone. A is not mentioned. C is true, but not why he went back to the doctor. D is not mentioned.

grammar.point: 被 + (N) + V得 + effect — made … by …
grammar.pattern: S + 被 + N + V + 得 + effect
grammar.explain: The passive pattern with 得 stresses the EFFECT on the subject: 我被這個感冒弄得很累 (this flu has worn me out).

examples.zh: 我被這個感冒弄得很累。
examples.id: This flu has really worn me out.

grammar.explain: 掉 after a verb = something is used up/thrown away/lost through that action: 吃掉 (eaten up), 丟掉 (thrown away), 用掉 (used up).

examples.id: My little brother ate all my medicine!

tasks.instr: Choose the right phrase for each blank. ONE option is not used.
tasks.text: 上個星期我感冒了，去（1）買藥。藥局的小姐說：「這個藥（2）飯後吃。」吃了兩天，我的（3）好多了，（4）也比較好。朋友看到我說：「你現在應該都（5）了吧？」

tasks.instr: Read these instructions for use, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 藥局的小姐說：這個藥一天吃三次，應該飯後吃，不能空肚子吃。吃了以後可能會想睡覺，所以吃藥以後最好別開車。吃三天以後，要是還發燒，就應該去醫院看醫生。
tasks.question: 吃了這個藥以後，最好不要做什麼？
tasks.why: 最好別開車 (it can make you sleepy). A: you must eat first. B is not mentioned. D is advised if the fever continues.

grammar.explain: 應該 gives advice or instructions: 應該飯後吃, 你應該多休息. Negative: 不應該 (shouldn't).

examples.id: You should take this medicine after meals.

grammar.explain: 應該 also expresses a fairly confident estimate: 她應該在路上了 (she should be on the way by now), 三天以後應該就好了.

examples.zh: 三天以後你應該就好了。

tasks.text: 我每天在公司坐八個小時，回家以後還（1）。上個月我的背和腿都開始痛，就去看了醫生。醫生說：「你（2），身體才會好。」他還說，別一直低頭，因為這樣（3）。所以現在我每天下班以後先去公園走四十分鐘，（4）。一個月以後，背真的不痛了，（5）。
tasks.why: (1) a bad habit at home. (2) pattern 要…才: 要每天動一動，身體才會好. (3) the reason not to look down. (4) 先…再: walk first, then go home for dinner. (5) an extra good result. 「對身體特別好的」 ends in 的, so it cannot finish any sentence.

tasks.instr: Read the text, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 很多人覺得，小孩子長得高不高，只跟爸爸媽媽的身高有關係。可是，吃得好、常常運動、晚上早點睡覺，也很重要。我弟弟小時候很瘦，也不高，可是他每天打籃球，晚上十點以前一定睡覺。現在他十八歲了，比爸爸還高一點。
tasks.question: 這個人想說什麼？
options: 身高不是只跟爸媽有關係
tasks.why: Main idea: 可是…也很重要 → height is not only about the parents. B is not mentioned. C: the text only says the brother is taller than the father, not that the father is tall. D over-generalises from one person.

grammar.explain: 才 marks that the result ONLY happens if the condition is met: 多運動，身體才會好 (you'll only be healthy if you exercise a lot). Compare 就: the condition is enough, the result follows easily.

examples.zh: 你要多運動，身體才會好。
examples.id: You have to exercise a lot to be healthy.

check.q: 'You have to study every day to pass the exam' =
options: 要每天念書，就才考得好。

grammar.explain: 才 also stresses an opinion, often contradicting someone: 我才不相信呢！ (I don't believe that at all!), 這才對 (now that's right).

examples.id: I don't believe that at all!
You're the one who should exercise more.

Talk about quizzes: 題目、回答、答案、結果
modules.exam_link: Rhetorical questions (不是…嗎) are a typical implicature pattern in 聽力 Part 4 — they mean a statement, not a question.

lines.zh: 大文，你不是說八點上課嗎？現在八點半了！

lines.zh: 對！我才出門，就八點了，結果遲到了。
lines.py: Duì! Wǒ cái chū mén, jiù bā diǎn le, jié guǒ chí dào le.
lines.id: Yes! I'd only just left and it was already eight, so I ended up late.

lines.zh: 大文，你又遲到了！
lines.py: Dà wén, nǐ yòu chí dào le!

lines.py: Wǒ! Dá àn shì "sān".
lines.id: Me! The answer is 'three'.

lines.zh: 對！大文立刻就回答了，很好。
lines.py: Duì! Dà wén lì kè jiù huí dá le, hěn hǎo.
lines.id: Correct! Dawen answered straight away — well done.

lines.zh: 第四題你會嗎？我才看，就頭痛了！
lines.py: Dì-sì tí nǐ huì ma? Wǒ cái kàn, jiù tóu tòng le!
lines.id: Can you do question four? I've only just looked at it and my head's spinning!

tasks.instr: Choose the right phrase for each blank. ONE option is not used.
tasks.text: 昨天上中文課，我（1）了十分鐘。老師說：「你（2）說今天會早一點來嗎？」我很不好意思。後來老師問了一個（3），我（4）就回答了。老師說：「你的（5）是對的，很好！」
tasks.why: (1) ten minutes late. (2) 不是…嗎 = didn't you. (3) a question. (4) answered at once. (5) your answer is right. 「題」 cannot stand alone like this (use 題目 or 第…題).

tasks.instr: Read the text, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 今天早上我七點半才起床，一看時鐘就知道要遲到了。我立刻出門，可是路上車很多，結果到學校的時候已經八點二十了。老師正在上課，問了我一個問題，我才坐下，還沒聽清楚題目，就要回答。結果我答錯了，同學們都笑了。
tasks.question: 這個人為什麼答錯了？
tasks.why: 還沒聽清楚題目，就要回答 → the direct cause. A is why he was late, not why he was wrong. B is not mentioned. D happened AFTER he got it wrong.

grammar.explain: A rhetorical question to reproach or remind: 你不是說八點上課嗎？ = you said 8 o'clock, didn't you? (but that's not how it turned out). The meaning is positive, despite the 不.

examples.id: Didn't you say class is at eight?

grammar.point: 才…就… — only just …, and already …
grammar.explain: The second event happens very soon after the first, often unexpectedly: 我才出門，就八點了 (I'd only just left, and it was already eight).

examples.id: I've only just looked at it and my head's spinning!

modules.scene: Dawen and Meimei talk about Taiwan's academic calendar and what they do in the semester breaks.
can_do: Express alternating activities: 有時候…，有時候…
Express two things at once: (也)…也…
Talk about the academic calendar: 學期、寒假、暑假、春假、放假
modules.exam_link: Holiday & semester schedules appear in 閱讀 Part 3 (academic calendars) and 聽力 Part 3.

lines.zh: 大文，寒假你做什麼？
lines.py: Dà wén, hán jià nǐ zuò shén me?
lines.id: Dawen, what do you do in the winter holidays?

lines.zh: 寒假我有時候回家，有時候去旅行。
lines.py: Hán jià wǒ yǒu shí hòu huí jiā, yǒu shí hòu qù lǚ xíng.

lines.py: Shǔ jià ne?

lines.zh: 臺灣的學期什麼時候放假？
lines.py: Tái wān de xué qí shén me shí hòu fàng jià?
lines.id: When are the holidays in the Taiwanese semester?

lines.zh: 一月放寒假，七月放暑假。春假只有幾天。
lines.py: Yī yuè fàng hán jià, qī yuè fàng shǔ jià. Chūn jià zhǐ yǒu jǐ tiān.
lines.id: January is the winter break and July the summer break. The spring break is only a few days.

lines.zh: 你放假的時候做什麼？
lines.py: Nǐ fàng jià de shí hòu zuò shén me?
lines.id: What do you do in the holidays?

lines.zh: 我也看書，也跟朋友出去玩。
lines.py: Wǒ yě kàn shū, yě gēn péng yǒu chū qù wán.
lines.id: I read, and I go out with friends too.

tasks.text: 這個（1）我很忙，每天都有很多功課。一月以後，我們就（2）了。寒假我（3）回印尼看家人，有時候在台北（4）。我覺得寒假太短了，比（5）短多了。

tasks.text: 臺灣的大學一年有兩個學期。第一個學期九月開始，一月結束，然後放寒假，大概一個月。第二個學期二月開始，六月結束，然後放暑假，差不多兩個多月。春假只有幾天，很多學生利用春假去旅行。

modules.title: 從明年起，我就要畢業了。
modules.title_py: Cóng míng nián qǐ, wǒ jiù yào bì yè le.
modules.title_id: From next year, I'll have graduated.
modules.scene: Dawen is about to graduate; he tells Meimei about his plans for research in education and his professor's support.
can_do: Express a starting point: 從…起
Stress an identity/place with 就 (就是、就在)
Talk about graduation & further study: 畢業、研究、教授、程度
modules.exam_link: Study & career plans appear in 閱讀 Part 5 and 聽力 Part 4. 就是 is often a pointer to the answer ('that's the one').

lines.zh: 大文，你什麼時候畢業？
lines.py: Dà wén, nǐ shén me shí hòu bì yè?
lines.id: Dawen, when do you graduate?

lines.zh: 明年六月。從明年起，我就不是學生了！
lines.py: Míng nián liù yuè. Cóng míng nián qǐ, wǒ jiù bú shì xué shēng le!

lines.py: Wǒ xiǎng yán jiū jiào yù. Chén jiào shòu shuō wǒ de Zhōng wén chéng dù hěn gāo.

lines.zh: 你的研究題目是什麼？
lines.py: Nǐ de yán jiū tí mù shì shén me?

lines.py: Jiù shì "Yìn ní xué shēng zěn me xué Zhōng wén".

lines.py: Hěn hǎo! Nǐ yí dìng huì chéng gōng. Chén jiào shòu zài nǎ lǐ?
lines.id: Great! You'll definitely succeed. Where's Professor Chen?

lines.zh: 就在那邊。從今天起，我每天看書三個小時。我希望得到教授的幫助，我說了就要做到！
lines.py: Jiù zài nà biān. Cóng jīn tiān qǐ, wǒ měi tiān kàn shū sān ge xiǎo shí. Wǒ xī wàng dé dào jiào shòu de bāng zhù, wǒ shuō le jiù yào zuò dào!
lines.id: Right over there. From today, I'm reading three hours a day. I hope to get the professor's help — what I say, I have to do!

lines.id: Eight!

lines.zh: 很好。十減四呢？
lines.py: Hěn hǎo. Shí jiǎn sì ne?
lines.id: Good. Ten minus four?

lines.zh: 六。三乘四是十二，十二除四是三。
lines.py: Liù. Sān chéng sì shì shí èr, shí èr chú sì shì sān.
lines.id: Six. Three times four is twelve, and twelve divided by four is three.

lines.zh: 對！十和四差多少？
lines.py: Duì! Shí hàn sì chā duō shǎo?
lines.id: Right! What's the difference between ten and four?

lines.zh: 差六！
lines.py: Chā liù!
lines.id: The difference is six!

lines.zh: 這裡有幾個蘋果？你數數看。
lines.py: Zhè lǐ yǒu jǐ ge píng guǒ? Nǐ shǔ shu kàn.
lines.id: How many apples are there here? Try counting them.

lines.zh: 一、二、三……有七個！
lines.py: Yī, èr, sān…… yǒu qī ge!
lines.id: One, two, three... there are seven!

lines.zh: 大文哥哥，二點五加一點五是多少？
lines.py: Dà wén gē ge, èr diǎn wǔ jiā yī diǎn wǔ shì duō shǎo?
lines.id: Dawen, what's two point five plus one point five?

lines.zh: 是四。你的數學很好！
lines.py: Shì sì. Nǐ de shù xué hěn hǎo!
lines.id: Four. You're good at maths!

lines.zh: 數學不困難，我很認真。
lines.py: Shù xué bú kùn nán, wǒ hěn rèn zhēn.
lines.id: Maths isn't hard — I study it seriously.

lines.zh: 零點五加零點五呢？你差一點就錯了！
lines.py: Líng diǎn wǔ jiā líng diǎn wǔ ne? Nǐ chà yì diǎn jiù cuò le!
lines.id: Zero point five plus zero point five? You almost got it wrong!

tasks.why: 2.5 is read 二點五. A drops the decimal point; B reverses the digits.

tasks.why: 100 − 60 = 40. A is the total price; C is the price of one apple.

比上次多了多少？
上次是七十八點五，多了十分。

tasks.question: 這位小姐上次考了幾分？
tasks.why: 上次是七十八點五. A is this time's score. C is the difference. D is not mentioned.

tasks.why: 乘 = times: 2 × 6 = 12. A is addition; C division.

tasks.why: Five apples → 五個. A and B are the wrong number.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the right word for the blank.
tasks.text: 他寫作業很（　），一個字也沒寫錯。
tasks.why: 很認真 = very careful/serious. 困難 does not describe how he writes; 數 is a verb.

tasks.instr: Choose the right phrase for each blank. ONE option is not used.
tasks.text: 我妹妹今年上國小，她很（1），每天都做數學作業。昨天她問我：「八（2）二是多少？」我說：「是四。」她又問：「三（3）三呢？」我說：「是九。」然後她（4）了桌子上的蘋果，有十個。她說：「十（5）三是七，我吃三個，還有七個！」
tasks.why: (1) hard-working. (2) 8 ÷ 2 = 4. (3) 3 × 3 = 9. (4) counted the apples. (5) 10 − 3 = 7. 「困難」 fits no blank.

tasks.instr: Read this homework, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 我弟弟今年八歲，他覺得數學很困難，每次數學都只有六十分。我發現他不是不認真，是不喜歡數學。所以我叫他數家裡的東西，例如：桌子上有幾個蘋果，一個蘋果二十塊，一共多少錢。現在他覺得數學很有意思，上個月考了九十分。
tasks.question: 弟弟為什麼現在覺得數學有意思？
options: 哥哥用家裡的東西教他
tasks.why: 叫他數家裡的東西 → a new way that made him like it. A: he was serious from the start. B is the result, not the cause. D is not mentioned.

grammar.point: 四則運算 — the four arithmetic operations
grammar.pattern: A + 加/減/乘/除 + B + 是 + C
grammar.explain: 加 (plus), 減 (minus), 乘 (times), 除 (divided by; spoken 十二除四 = 12 ÷ 4). The result is introduced with 是.

grammar.pattern: whole number + 點 + digits (read one by one)
grammar.explain: The decimal point is read 點; the digits after it are read one by one: 3.14 = 三點一四. A leading zero: 零點五 (0.5).

supplement.meaning: difference; short of (十和四差六; 差一分 = one point short)

modules.title: 三分之一的學生每天運動。
modules.title_py: Sān fēn zhī yī de xué shēng měi tiān yùn dòng.
modules.title_id: A third of the students exercise every day.
modules.scene: The teacher shares the results of a class survey about students' habits: exercise, coffee and sleeping hours.
can_do: Say fractions: 三分之一
Say percentages: 百分之八十
Read the results of a simple survey: 許多、包括、一切、當中
modules.exam_link: Percentages & fractions appear in 閱讀 Part 5 (survey results, opinion essays) and 聽力 Part 4; questions often ask you to work out a part of a part.

lines.zh: 我問了我們班的同學。我們班有三十個學生，三分之一的學生每天運動。
lines.py: Wǒ wèn le wǒ men bān de tóng xué. Wǒ men bān yǒu sān shí ge xué shēng, sān fēn zhī yī de xué shēng měi tiān yùn dòng.
lines.id: I asked our class. There are thirty students, and a third of them exercise every day.

lines.zh: 那是十個學生！
lines.py: Nà shì shí ge xué shēng!
lines.id: So that's ten people!

lines.zh: 對。百分之八十的學生喜歡喝咖啡。
lines.py: Duì. Bǎi fēn zhī bā shí de xué shēng xǐ huān hē kā fēi.
lines.id: Right. Eighty per cent like drinking coffee.

lines.zh: 包括老師嗎？
lines.py: Bāo kuò lǎo shī ma?
lines.id: Does that include the teacher?

lines.zh: 不包括。一切都是學生說的。
lines.py: Bù bāo kuò. Yí qiè dōu shì xué shēng shuō de.
lines.id: No. It's all from the students' answers.

lines.zh: 許多同學說他們很忙，當中一半每天睡覺的時間只有六個小時。
lines.py: Xǔ duō tóng xué shuō tā men hěn máng, dāng zhōng yí bàn měi tiān shuì jiào de shí jiān zhǐ yǒu liù ge xiǎo shí.
lines.id: Lots of classmates say they're busy — half of them only sleep six hours a day.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture. Listen to the question and answers A–C, then choose the answer that matches the picture.
tasks.question: 這是多少？
tasks.why: Half a circle → 50% = 百分之五十. A and B are misread.

tasks.question: 多少人喜歡喝茶？

tasks.question: 公園裡有什麼人？
tasks.why: Lots of people strolling → 許多人. A and B are the wrong number.

tasks.audio: 你們班有多少學生喜歡運動？
tasks.why: The question asks how many like it → 三分之一. A is about himself; C is the class total.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 2 · One-turn question & answer
tasks.instr: Listen to the sentence, then choose the most suitable response.
tasks.why: The question is whether it is included → 包括. A and C do not answer.

lines.zh: 我們公司有一百個人。
喝咖啡的人多嗎？
很多，百分之七十的人每天都喝。
那不喝的有三十個人。

tasks.question: 不喝咖啡的有多少人？
tasks.why: 100 − 70% = 30 people. A is those who drink it; C is the total.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 4 · Dialogue + implied meaning
tasks.instr: Listen to the dialogue, then choose the correct answer.

一萬兩千塊。
包括飛機票嗎？
包括飛機票和飯店，可是不包括吃飯的錢。

tasks.question: 一萬兩千塊不包括什麼？
tasks.why: 不包括吃飯的錢. A and B are included. D contradicts it.

tasks.text: 班上三分之二的學生是女生。
tasks.why: 三分之二是女生 → two out of three are girls. A is reversed; B does not match.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the matching sentence.
tasks.why: A quarter of the circle → 百分之二十五. A and C are wrong.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the right word for the blank.
tasks.text: 一共十個人，（　）老師。
tasks.why: 包括 = including. 許多老師 and 一切老師 do not fit 'ten in total'.

tasks.instr: Choose the right phrase for each blank. ONE option is not used.
tasks.text: 我們班有四十個學生。老師問大家喜歡不喜歡中文，（1）的學生說喜歡，就是三十個人。（2）喜歡中文的學生（3），有十個人每天都看中文電影。老師說：「（4）都是因為你們很認真。」這個問題的結果，（5）老師自己。
tasks.why: (1) 3/4 of 40 = 30. (2)(3) 在…當中 = among. (4) 一切 = everything. (5) does not include the teacher. 「百分之二十」 is a wrong calculation: 20% of 40 is only 8.

tasks.instr: Read the text, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 學校問了三百個學生：「你每天睡覺的時間有多長？」結果，三分之一的學生每天睡覺的時間只有五個小時，當中許多人說是因為晚上要打工。百分之二十的學生說他們睡覺的時間夠。
tasks.question: 睡覺時間只有五個小時的學生，許多是因為什麼？
tasks.why: 當中許多人說是因為晚上要打工. A, C and D are not mentioned.

grammar.explain: Fractions are read from the DENOMINATOR first: 三分之一 = 1/3 (one of three parts), 四分之三 = 3/4. The opposite of the English order ('one third').

examples.zh: 三分之一的學生每天運動。
examples.id: A third of the students exercise every day.

grammar.explain: Per cent = 'out of a hundred parts': 百分之八十 = 80%, 百分之五 = 5%.

examples.zh: 百分之八十的學生喜歡喝咖啡。
examples.id: Eighty per cent of the students like coffee.

modules.title: 台北的房租是雅加達的兩倍左右。
modules.title_py: Tái běi de fáng zū shì Yǎ jiā dá de liǎng bèi zuǒ yòu.
modules.title_id: Rent in Taipei is about twice as much as in Jakarta.
modules.scene: Dawen compares the cost of living in Taipei and Jakarta with Meimei: rent, the price of coffee, and ticket prices by age.
can_do: Express multiples: A 是 B 的 … 倍
Give estimates: number + 左右
Express limits: …以上／…以下
modules.exam_link: Multiples, ranges and age/price limits often appear in 閱讀 Part 3 (ticket price boards) and 聽力 Parts 3–4.

lines.zh: 美美，台北的房租是雅加達的兩倍左右！
lines.py: Měi měi, Tái běi de fáng zū shì Yǎ jiā dá de liǎng bèi zuǒ yòu!
lines.id: Meimei, rent in Taipei is about twice as much as in Jakarta!

lines.zh: 真的嗎？你一個月房租多少？
lines.py: Zhēn de ma? Nǐ yí ge yuè fáng zū duō shǎo?
lines.id: Really? How much is your rent a month?

lines.zh: 八千塊左右。雅加達是四千塊左右。
lines.py: Bā qiān kuài zuǒ yòu. Yǎ jiā dá shì sì qiān kuài zuǒ yòu.
lines.id: About eight thousand. In Jakarta it's about four thousand.

lines.zh: 這個房子的房租，八千塊以上嗎？
lines.py: Zhè ge fáng zi de fáng zū, bā qiān kuài yǐ shàng ma?
lines.id: Is the rent for this house over eight thousand?

lines.zh: 九千塊以上。可是二十五歲以下的學生可以便宜一點。
lines.py: Jiǔ qiān kuài yǐ shàng. Kě shì èr shí wǔ suì yǐ xià de xué shēng kě yǐ pián yí yì diǎn.
lines.id: Over nine thousand. But students under 25 can get it cheaper.

lines.zh: 台北的咖啡也比雅加達貴，差不多是三倍！
lines.py: Tái běi de kā fēi yě bǐ Yǎ jiā dá guì, chà bù duō shì sān bèi!
lines.id: Coffee in Taipei is more expensive than in Jakarta too — almost three times as much!

八千塊左右，是我在印尼的兩倍。
那你在印尼的房租是多少？
四千塊左右。

tasks.why: 8,000 is twice the rent in Indonesia → 4,000. A is the rent in Taipei; C goes the wrong way (multiplying, not dividing).

三千塊左右。
這麼貴！是我上次買的三倍。
可是這雙比較好，可以穿很久。

tasks.question: 這位先生上次買的鞋子大概多少錢？
tasks.why: 3,000 is three times the old price → 1,000. A is the price now. C goes the wrong way (multiplying). D is a wrong sum.

tasks.instr: Read the sentence, then choose the matching picture.
tasks.text: 這個蛋糕兩百塊，是那個的兩倍。
tasks.why: 200 = twice 100. A is the same price; B is reversed (half).

今天三十五度左右，很熱。

tasks.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the right word for the blank.
tasks.text: 十八歲（　）的人才可以開車。
tasks.why: 才可以開車 → 18 and over: 以上. 以下 is the opposite; 左右 = about, not used for an age limit.

tasks.instr: Choose the right phrase for each blank. ONE option is not used.
tasks.text: 我在台北租了一個房間，房租一個月八千塊（1），差不多是雅加達的兩（2）。台北的咖啡也很貴，一杯一百塊（3）。可是二十五歲（4）的學生，可以便宜百分之十。我今年二十二歲，所以（5）便宜一點。
tasks.why: (1) about. (2) twice as much. (3) 100 or more. (4) 25 or under. (5) can be cheaper. 「一半」 fits no blank.

tasks.instr: Read this ticket board, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 這個公園星期一休息，早上九點到下午五點開門。票：大人一百塊。十二歲以下的小孩是大人的一半，六十五歲以上的老人不用錢。
tasks.question: 一個十歲的小孩要多少錢？
tasks.why: Ten is under 12 → half the adult price = 50. A is the adult price. C is for those 65 and over. D is double.

grammar.pattern: A + 是 + B + 的 + number + 倍
grammar.explain: A 是 B 的 X 倍 = A is X times B. You can also use 比: A 比 B 貴一倍 (one times more expensive = twice the price).

examples.zh: 台北的房租是雅加達的兩倍左右。
examples.id: Rent in Taipei is about twice as much as in Jakarta.

check.q: 'My class is three times the size of his' =
options: 我們班是他們班的三倍。
我們班是三倍他們班的。

grammar.explain: 左右 AFTER a number = about/approximately: 八千塊左右, 三十度左右, 兩倍左右. Different from 差不多, which goes BEFORE the number.

examples.id: About eight thousand.

modules.title: 打八折！一件比一件便宜。
modules.title_py: Dǎ bā zhé! Yí jiàn bǐ yí jiàn pián yí.
modules.title_id: 20% off! Cheaper and cheaper.
modules.scene: The department store is having a big sale. Dawen and Meimei join the queue, compare prices and judge the sizes of clothes.
can_do: Understand Taiwanese discounts: 打八折 (pay 80%)
Make successive comparisons: 一件比一件…
Say 'a bit too …': Vs了一點 (貴了一點)
modules.exam_link: Taiwanese-style discounts (打X折 = pay X0%) are a classic trap for learners in 聽力 Part 3 and 閱讀 Part 3.

lines.zh: 大文，百貨公司今天打八折！
lines.py: Dà wén, bǎi huò gōng sī jīn tiān dǎ bā zhé!
lines.id: Dawen, the department store has 20% off today!

lines.zh: 真的嗎？我們去逛街吧！
lines.py: Zhēn de ma? Wǒ men qù guàng jiē ba!
lines.id: Really? Let's go shopping!

lines.zh: 人好多，好熱鬧！大家都在排隊。
lines.py: Rén hǎo duō, hǎo rè nào! Dà jiā dōu zài pái duì.
lines.id: There are so many people — it's so busy! Everyone's queuing.

lines.zh: 你看，這裡的衣服一件比一件便宜！
lines.py: Nǐ kàn, zhè lǐ de yī fú yí jiàn bǐ yí jiàn pián yí!
lines.id: Look, the clothes here get cheaper and cheaper!

lines.zh: 這件外套打八折，還是貴了一點。
lines.py: Zhè jiàn wài tào dǎ bā zhé, hái shì guì le yì diǎn.
lines.id: This jacket's 20% off, but it's still a bit too expensive.

lines.zh: 那件呢？
lines.py: Nà jiàn ne?
lines.id: What about that one?

lines.zh: 那件大了一點。我們再逛一下吧。
lines.py: Nà jiàn dà le yì diǎn. Wǒ men zài guàng yí xià ba.
lines.id: That one's a bit too big. Let's look around a bit more.

grammar.point: 一 M 比一 M — more and more …

tasks.text: 冬天到了，我去買衣服。我先看了一件金色的上衣，很漂亮，可是太貴了。後來我買了一件紅紅的毛衣，賣衣服的小姐說這件毛衣很適合我。我也買了手套和襪子，因為我的手和腳常常很冷。回家以後，媽媽說：「這件毛衣看起來很舒服，很合適。」

grammar.point: AA的 + N — reduplicated adjectives as modifiers
grammar.explain: A one-syllable adjective is repeated and + 的 to describe a noun vividly: 紅紅的毛衣 (a bright red sweater), 長長的頭髮. No 很.

examples.id: This red sweater is pretty.

grammar.pattern: S + Vs Vs + 的 ／ S + AABB + 的
grammar.explain: Reduplication can also be the predicate (with 的 at the end): 皮鞋黑黑的 (the shoes are jet black), 房間乾乾淨淨的 (the room is spotless). No 很.

examples.id: These shoes are jet black.
The room is spotless.

modules.title: 你沒有零錢嗎？
modules.title_py: Nǐ méi yǒu líng qián ma?
modules.title_id: Don't you have any small change?
modules.scene: In a shop, Dawen can't pay by card for a small purchase. At a restaurant, Meimei asks about tipping in Taiwan.
can_do: Ask in surprise with 不/沒…嗎？ (你沒有零錢嗎？)
Ask whether something has happened yet with …了沒有？
Talk about ways of paying: 刷卡、零錢、小費、剛好
modules.exam_link: Negative questions (你不知道嗎？) carry surprise — often tested in 聽力 Part 4 as implied meaning.

tasks.text: 昨天我去一家小店買東西，一共六十塊。我問店員：「可以（1）嗎？」店員說：「一百塊以下不能刷卡，你（2）零錢嗎？」我打開錢包一看，（3）有六十塊。吃晚飯的時候，我問朋友：「臺灣要給（4）嗎？」朋友說：「不用給，你不知道（5）？」
tasks.why: (1) pay by card. (2) 沒有…嗎 = don't you have …? (3) exactly 60. (4) a tip. (5) 不知道嗎 = didn't you know? 「店員」 fits no blank.

tasks.question: 這個人為什麼現在出門會帶零錢？

grammar.explain: 沒有 at the end of a sentence after 了 forms a 'yet or not' question: 你付錢了沒有？ Answer: V了／還沒(有).

grammar.pattern: S + 不/沒(有) + VP + 嗎？
grammar.explain: A question with a negative word shows SURPRISE or expects the answer 'yes': 你不知道嗎？ (you didn't know?), 你沒有零錢嗎？

tasks.text: 我家附近的市場有一家水果店，主人是一位老闆娘。她已經做了三十年的生意了。她說，做生意最重要的不是賣得多，是讓客人高高興興地回家。所以要是水果不好，她一定不賣。有一次我買的蘋果不甜，她就再給了我一籃子。

grammar.explain: 地 (de) links an adverbial of MANNER to the verb: 高興地說 (to say happily), 慢慢地走. Remember the trio: 的 + noun, 地 + verb, V + 得 + result.

grammar.explain: An adjective is repeated (慢慢, 好好, 高高興興) and + 地 to describe vividly how something is done: 你慢慢地看 (take your time looking), 好好地吃飯.

grammar.point: 一點也/都 + 不/沒 — not … at all
grammar.pattern: S + 一點也/都 + 不/沒 + VP

grammar.point: 從來 + 不/沒 — never (at all)
grammar.pattern: S + 從來 + 不 + V ／ 從來 + 沒 + V過
grammar.explain: 從來不 = never (a habit/principle); 從來沒V過 = have never once (experience).

lines.zh: 可以在學校辦嗎？

lines.py: Yǒu. Nǐ yǒu shén me wèn tí, dōu kě yǐ tí chū lái.

lines.zh: 辦居留證要多久？

lines.zh: 只要一個星期就好了。
lines.py: Zhǐ yào yí ge xīng qí jiù hǎo le.

tasks.text: 外國學生來臺灣念書，要是住半年以上，就一定要辦居留證。只有在一個地方才能辦，學校不能辦。辦的時候，只要帶兩張照片，一個星期就好了。那裡有英文服務，有問題都可以提出來。

tasks.why: Three months is under half a year → not needed. A ignores the 半年以上 condition. C is a requirement, not an answer. D is the opposite (學校不能辦).

grammar.point: 只要…就… — as long as …, then …
grammar.explain: 只要 = as long as: the condition is ENOUGH, and the result is certain. Its partner is 就.

examples.zh: 只要帶兩張照片，就可以辦。

check.q: 'As long as you work hard, you'll definitely manage' =
options: 只要你用功，就一定可以。
只有你用功，就一定可以。
只要你用功，才一定可以。

grammar.pattern: 只有 + the only condition，(S) + 才 + result
grammar.explain: 只有 = only: that condition is the ONLY way. Its partner is 才 (not 就). Compare 只要…就… (a sufficient condition).

examples.id: You can only apply here.

lines.zh: 你看得出來那封信是我寫的嗎？

lines.zh: 大文，昨天晚上宿舍附近發生了一件事。
lines.py: Dà wén, zuó tiān wǎn shang sù shè fù jìn fā shēng le yí jiàn shì.
lines.id: Dawen, something happened near the dorm last night.

lines.zh: 什麼事？
lines.py: Shén me shì?
lines.id: What happened?

lines.zh: 有人偷了一輛機車。
lines.py: Yǒu rén tōu le yí liàng jī chē.
lines.id: Someone stole a scooter.

lines.zh: 真的嗎？小偷抓到了嗎？

lines.zh: 抓到了！小偷跑了，可是被大家抓住了！
lines.py: Zhuā dào le! Xiǎo tōu pǎo le, kě shì bèi dà jiā zhuā zhù le!
lines.id: Yes! The thief ran off, but people caught him!

lines.zh: 我昨天很怕，一直睡不著。
lines.py: Wǒ zuó tiān hěn pà, yì zhí shuì bù zháo.

lines.py: Méi yǒu. Wǒ yǐ wéi qián bāo diū le, hòu lái zhǎo zháo le, zài shā fā dǐ xià.

tasks.text: 昨天晚上學校附近（1）了一件事。有人想（2）一輛機車，可是被大家（3）了。我聽了很怕，晚上一直（4）。今天早上我找不到錢包，以為（5）了，後來在書包裡找著了。

tasks.instr: Read this news report, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 上個星期我家附近發生了一件事：半夜兩點，有一個小偷想偷鄰居的機車。鄰居的狗一直叫，大家都聽見了，出來一看，小偷就跑了。可是他跑得太慢，被兩個年輕人抓住了。那天晚上，我怕得睡不著，一直到早上才上床休息。
tasks.question: 小偷為什麼被抓住了？

grammar.explain: 住 after a verb = the action leaves something held/fixed: 抓住 (to catch and hold), 停住 (to come to a stop).

examples.id: People caught the thief!

grammar.explain: 著 is read zháo after a verb = the goal is achieved: 睡著 (to fall asleep), 找著 (to find). Often in the potential form: 睡不著 (can't fall asleep). Different from 著 zhe (B08).

examples.id: I just couldn't get to sleep.
I've found my wallet.

modules.title: 颱風天出門會很危險的。
modules.title_py: Tái fēng tiān chū mén huì hěn wéi xiǎn de.
modules.title_id: Going out in a typhoon is bound to be dangerous.
modules.scene: A typhoon hits Taipei. Meimei warns Dawen to stay indoors; after the typhoon passes, Dawen promises not to take risks again.
can_do: Express certainty/warnings: 會…的
Say 'no longer': 不再…了
Talk about safety: 危險、安全、保護、可怕
modules.exam_link: Safety warnings (typhoons, earthquakes) are classic material for 閱讀 Parts 1–3 and 聽力 Part 4.

lines.zh: 大文，颱風來了，你別出門！颱風天出門會很危險的。
lines.py: Dà wén, tái fēng lái le, nǐ bié chū mén! Tái fēng tiān chū mén huì hěn wéi xiǎn de.
lines.id: Dawen, the typhoon's coming — don't go out! Going out in a typhoon is bound to be dangerous.

lines.zh: 好。我們在家很安全。
lines.py: Hǎo. Wǒ men zài jiā hěn ān quán.
lines.id: OK. We're safe at home.

lines.zh: 要保護好自己，窗戶也要關好。
lines.py: Yào bǎo hù hǎo zì jǐ, chuāng hù yě yào guān hǎo.
lines.id: Look after yourself, and shut the windows tight.

lines.zh: 昨天的颱風很可怕！以後颱風天，我不再出門了。
lines.py: Zuó tiān de tái fēng hěn kě pà! Yǐ hòu tái fēng tiān, wǒ bú zài chū mén le.
lines.id: Yesterday's typhoon was scary! From now on I won't go out in a typhoon again.

lines.zh: 也許明天還會下雨。
lines.py: Yě xǔ míng tiān hái huì xià yǔ.
lines.id: It might still rain tomorrow.

lines.zh: 沒關係，我會在家的。
lines.py: Méi guān xi, wǒ huì zài jiā de.
lines.id: That's fine — I'll definitely stay at home.

tasks.text: 上個星期颱風來了，外面的風很大，很（1）。媽媽說：「今天別出門，出門會很危險（2）。」我們在家很（3）。晚上我看新聞，看到很多（4）的照片。我想，以後颱風天，我（5）出門了。
tasks.why: (1) dangerous. (2) 會…的 = certainly. (3) safe at home. (4) frightening photos. (5) 不再…了 = no longer. 「保護」 is a verb and fits no blank.

tasks.instr: Read this warning, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 颱風來的時候，最好在家裡，不要出門。要是一定要出門，也要注意安全，因為路上可能有東西掉下來，很危險。窗戶要關好，也要保護好家裡的小孩和老人。颱風走了以後，也許還會下雨，所以別太早出去。

tasks.why: 也許還會下雨，所以別太早出去. A is not mentioned. C and D are advice during the typhoon, not this reason.

grammar.explain: 會…的 stresses the speaker's conviction that something will/is bound to happen, often for warnings or promises: 會很危險的, 我會在家的.

examples.zh: 颱風天出門會很危險的。
examples.id: Going out in a typhoon is bound to be dangerous.
I'll definitely stay at home.

grammar.explain: 不再…了 = to stop doing (no longer), for a change of habit: 我不再喝咖啡了.

examples.zh: 以後颱風天，我不再出門了。
examples.id: From now on I won't go out in a typhoon again.

lines.zh: 大文，你看，天上有一顆一顆的星星！

lines.py: Duì. Xià tiān tài yáng hěn dà, qiū tiān xīng xing hěn duō.
lines.id: Yes. In summer the sun is fierce, and in autumn there are lots of stars.

lines.zh: 你看那一朵一朵的花！多麼漂亮啊！
lines.py: Nǐ kàn nà yì duǒ yì duǒ de huā! Duō me piào liang a!

tasks.text: 上個週末我們去山上看星星。那天晚上沒有月亮，天上有一顆一顆的星星，多麼美麗啊！我們坐下來，把背包放下，一直看到半夜。朋友說，山上的星星比市區多很多，因為山上的空氣很好。

grammar.point: 一M一M的 — one by one / lots
grammar.pattern: 一 + M + 一 + M + 的 + N
grammar.explain: The measure word is repeated with 一 to describe lots of things seen one by one: 一顆一顆的星星, 一朵一朵的花.

examples.zh: 天上有一顆一顆的星星！
examples.id: There are stars (scattered) all over the sky!

grammar.explain: 下 after a verb = moving down or the result of being 'left/placed': 坐下 (to sit down), 放下 (to put down).

modules.title: 垃圾不是紙，就是瓶子。
modules.title_py: Lā jī bú shì zhǐ, jiù shì píng zi.
modules.title_id: The rubbish is either paper or bottles.
modules.scene: Dawen learns to sort rubbish in Taiwan and compares environmental problems in Taiwan and Indonesia.
can_do: Say 'if it's not A, it's B': 不是…就是…
Stress with 連…都/也 + 不/沒
Talk about the environment: 環保、污染、社會、自由
modules.exam_link: Light essays about the environment & recycling appear in 閱讀 Part 5. 連…都… marks strong emphasis.

lines.zh: 美美，這個袋子裡的垃圾，不是紙，就是瓶子。
lines.py: Měi měi, zhè ge dài zi lǐ de lā jī, bú shì zhǐ, jiù shì píng zi.
lines.id: Meimei, the rubbish in this bag is either paper or bottles.

lines.zh: 對，紙和瓶子要放在不同的地方。
lines.py: Duì, zhǐ hé píng zi yào fàng zài bù tóng de dì fāng.
lines.id: Yes, paper and bottles have to go in different places.

lines.zh: 為什麼？
lines.py: Wèi shén me?
lines.id: Why?

lines.zh: 為了環保。垃圾太多，會污染環境。你不能自由地丟垃圾。
lines.py: Wèi le huán bǎo. Lā jī tài duō, huì wū rǎn huán jìng. Nǐ bù néng zì yóu de diū lā jī.
lines.id: It's for the environment. Too much rubbish pollutes the environment. You can't throw rubbish away just anywhere.

lines.zh: 印尼的垃圾問題很嚴重。
lines.py: Yìn ní de lā jī wèn tí hěn yán zhòng.
lines.id: Indonesia's rubbish problem is serious.

lines.zh: 臺灣以前也是，連海邊都有很多垃圾。
lines.py: Tái wān yǐ qián yě shì, lián hǎi biān dōu yǒu hěn duō lā jī.
lines.id: Taiwan used to be like that too — even the beaches were covered in rubbish.

lines.zh: 現在呢？
lines.py: Xiàn zài ne?
lines.id: And now?

lines.zh: 現在社會上大家都很注意環保。
lines.py: Xiàn zài shè huì shàng dà jiā dōu hěn zhù yì huán bǎo.
lines.id: Now everyone in society pays attention to the environment.

tasks.instr: Choose the right phrase for each blank. ONE option is not used.
tasks.text: 我們學校很注意（1），垃圾要分開丟：紙放一個地方，瓶子放一個地方。我的垃圾（2）紙，（3）瓶子，所以很容易。我覺得要是大家都亂丟垃圾，環境就會被（4）。現在（5）小孩都知道怎麼丟垃圾了。
tasks.why: (1) environmental protection. (2)(3) 不是…就是… = if not …, then …. (4) polluted. (5) 連…都 = even. 「自由」 fits no blank.

tasks.instr: Read the text, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 以前這條河很乾淨，很多人在河邊散步。後來附近的人越來越多，大家都把垃圾丟在河裡，河被污染了，連魚都不見了。這幾年大家越來越注意環保，不能自由地丟垃圾，河也慢慢乾淨了。現在河邊又有人散步了。
tasks.question: 河為什麼又乾淨了？
tasks.why: 大家越來越注意環保 → the river is clean again. A and B are causes of the pollution. D is the result, not the cause.

grammar.pattern: 連 + the extreme case + 都/也 + (不/沒) + VP
grammar.explain: 連 marks the most unexpected case, followed by 都/也: 連海邊都有垃圾 (even the beaches have rubbish). With a negative for strong emphasis: 連一口水都沒喝.

examples.id: Even the beaches were covered in rubbish.

options: 我連他的名字都不知道。
我都連他的名字不知道。
連我他的名字不知道都。

grammar.point: 不是…就是… — if it's not …, it's …
grammar.explain: There are only two possibilities: 不是 A 就是 B (if not A, then definitely B). Often used to describe habits: 不是在家，就是去打工.

examples.id: The rubbish is either paper or bottles.

check.q: 他週末不是睡覺，就是看電視 means…

lines.zh: 美美，春節是臺灣最重要的節日嗎？

lines.zh: 對！除夕晚上，大家一起吃晚飯。

lines.id: What do you eat?

lines.zh: 魚、雞、青菜等等，都是傳統的中式菜。

lines.zh: 除夕的時候，你們誰先吃？

lines.zh: 我們家誰先到，誰就先吃！
lines.py: Wǒ men jiā shéi xiān dào, shéi jiù xiān chī!
lines.id: In my family, whoever arrives first eats first!

lines.zh: 真有意思！
lines.py: Zhēn yǒu yì si!
lines.id: That's so interesting!

lines.zh: 你們在印尼有聖誕老人嗎？

lines.zh: 有，可是東方的節日我也很喜歡。今年除夕，我可以去你家嗎？
lines.py: Yǒu, kě shì dōng fāng de jié rì wǒ yě hěn xǐ huān. Jīn nián chú xī, wǒ kě yǐ qù nǐ jiā ma?
lines.id: Yes, but I like Eastern festivals too. Can I come to your home on New Year's Eve this year?

lines.zh: 當然可以！你想吃什麼，我們就做什麼！
lines.py: Dāng rán kě yǐ! Nǐ xiǎng chī shén me, wǒ men jiù zuò shén me!
lines.id: Of course! Whatever you want to eat, we'll cook it!

grammar.pattern: S + 不知道 + question clause (no 嗎)

grammar.point: 不但…還/也… — not only …, but also …

grammar.point: 不但…而且… — not only …, but even …
grammar.pattern: S + 不但 + A，而且 + (還) + B
grammar.explain: A stronger form than 不但…還…: 而且 introduces a second, more surprising point. 還 can be added after 而且.

tasks.text: 我本來以為住在宿舍（1），因為房租便宜，走路五分鐘就到教室。住了一個學期以後，我才發現（2）。我的室友每天晚上都在房間裡大聲講電話，（3）。我跟他說了好幾次，可是他（4）。最後我決定搬出去。其實住宿舍也有好處，只是（5）。
tasks.why: (1) the first assumption (本來以為) = 只有好處. (2) 才發現 → it was not that simple. (3) the result of a noisy roommate. (4) he was told several times but it was 還是一樣. (5) 其實…只是 不適合我. 「可惜我沒有搬家」 contradicts the text: he did move out.

tasks.instr: Read the text, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 大學一年級的時候，我住在學校宿舍。宿舍很便宜，離教室也很近，我還認識了很多朋友。可是四個人住一個房間，有人要念書，有人要打電話，常常很吵。二年級我就搬出去，一個人租了一個小房間。現在不吵了，可是房租貴了很多，有時候也覺得一個人有點無聊。
tasks.question: 這個人覺得搬出宿舍以後怎麼樣？
tasks.why: After moving: 不吵了 (a plus) but 房租貴、有點無聊 (minuses). B ignores the downsides. C is the opposite (房租貴了很多). D: he had many friends when he lived in the dorm.

grammar.pattern: S + 本來 + VP，(後來/可是…)
grammar.explain: 本來 = the original situation or plan, which later changed: 我本來想學法律，後來學了中文.

grammar.pattern: V + 下去 ／ V + 不下去
grammar.explain: 下去 after a verb = to keep going: 說下去 (carry on talking). The negative potential: 看不下去 (can't go on watching/reading).

examples.id: Go on with your story!
I can't go on reading this book.

grammar.point: V得下／V不下 — fits / doesn't fit
grammar.explain: 下 with 得/不 expresses whether there is ROOM: 吃不下 (can't eat any more), 放得下 (still fits), 坐不下 (not enough seats).

examples.id: I can't fit anything else in now.

examples.id: Outside Taipei, it takes two hours.

grammar.explain: A verb phrase + 的 can stand as a noun: 我要的 (what I want), 你說的 (what you said). Often in the pattern 我要的是… to correct something.

examples.id: What I ordered is beef.
Is this the bento you ordered?
